  have hnorm : ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (k * m') = ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (k' * m) := by
    have hc := congrArg norm ekey
    rwa [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_zpow, norm_zpow, norm_natCast_p p, norm_pow,
      norm_pow, hny, hny', one_pow, one_pow, mul_one, mul_one] at hc
  have hpinv0 : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by have := hp.out.pos; positivity
  have hpinv1 : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 1 := by
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.out.one_lt
    have : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ h1
    linarith
  have hexp : k * m' = k' * m := zpow_right_injective₀ hpinv0 hpinv1 hnorm
  
  have hyeq : y ^ m' = y' ^ m := by
    rw [hexp] at ekey
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (zpow_ne_zero _ hpL) ekey
  have hlog := congrArg (padicLog p) hyeq
  rw [padicLog_pow p hy, padicLog_pow p hy'] at hlog
  
  have hmne : (m : ℚ_[p]) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
  have hm'ne : (m' : ℚ_[p]) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm'.ne'
  have hcast : (m' : ℚ_[p]) • padicLog p y = (m : ℚ_[p]) • padicLog p y' := by
    rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]; exact hlog
  have lhs : ((m : ℚ_[p]))⁻¹ • padicLog p y
      = (((m' : ℚ_[p]) * (m : ℚ_[p]))⁻¹) • ((m' : ℚ_[p]) • padicLog p y) := by
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_comm (m' : ℚ_[p])⁻¹, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hm'ne, mul_one]
  have rhs : ((m' : ℚ_[p]))⁻¹ • padicLog p y'
      = (((m' : ℚ_[p]) * (m : ℚ_[p]))⁻¹) • ((m : ℚ_[p]) • padicLog p y') := by
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hmne, mul_one]
  rw [lhs, rhs, hcast]

name: extLog_eq_of_witness
statement:
theorem extLog_eq_of_witness {x : L} {m : ℕ} {k : ℤ} {y : L} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hxy : x ^ m = (p : L) ^ k * y) (hy : InExpBall p (y - 1)) :
    extLog p x = ((m : ℚ_[p]))⁻¹ • padicLog p y
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : ExtLogDomain p x := ⟨m, k, y, hm, hxy, hy⟩
  rw [extLog, dif_pos hdom]
  obtain ⟨hm₀, hxy₀, hy₀⟩ := hdom.choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec
  exact extLog_witness_smul_eq p hm₀ hm hxy₀ hxy hy₀ hy

name: inExpBall_one_sub_one
statement: theorem inExpBall_one_sub_one : InExpBall p ((1 : L) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_self, InExpBall, norm_zero, zero_pow (by have := hp.out.one_lt; omega)]
  exact inv_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hp.out.pos)

name: extLog_eq_padicLog
statement:
theorem extLog_eq_padicLog {x : L} (hx : InExpBall p (x - 1)) :
    extLog p x = padicLog p x
proof:
:= by
  rw [extLog_eq_of_witness p one_pos (by rw [pow_one, zpow_zero, one_mul]) hx,
    Nat.cast_one, inv_one, one_smul]

name: extLog_mul
statement:
theorem extLog_mul {x y : L} (hx : ExtLogDomain p x) (hy : ExtLogDomain p y) :
    extLog p (x * y) = extLog p x + extLog p y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, k, a, hm, hxy, ha⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨m', k', b, hm', hxy', hb⟩ := hy
  have hpL : (p : L) ≠ 0 := natCast_p_ne_zero p
  
  have hball : InExpBall p (a ^ m' * b ^ m - 1) :=
    mul_mem_expBall p (pow_mem_expBall p ha m') (pow_mem_expBall p hb m)
  have hprod : (x * y) ^ (m * m')
      = (p : L) ^ (k * m' + k' * m) * (a ^ m' * b ^ m) := by
    rw [mul_pow, pow_mul x m m', hxy, mul_pow, mul_comm m m', pow_mul y m' m, hxy',
      mul_pow, ← zpow_natCast ((p : L) ^ k) m', ← zpow_mul,
      ← zpow_natCast ((p : L) ^ k') m, ← zpow_mul, zpow_add₀ hpL]
    ring
  
  rw [extLog_eq_of_witness p hm hxy ha, extLog_eq_of_witness p hm' hxy' hb,
    extLog_eq_of_witness p (Nat.mul_pos hm hm') hprod hball,
    padicLog_mul p (pow_mem_expBall p ha m') (pow_mem_expBall p hb m),
    padicLog_pow p ha, padicLog_pow p hb]
  
  have hmne : (m : ℚ_[p]) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
  have hm'ne : (m' : ℚ_[p]) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm'.ne'
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, smul_add, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℚ_[p] m' (padicLog p a),
    ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℚ_[p] m (padicLog p b), smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_inv]
  congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> field_simp

name: ExtLogDomain.mul
statement:
theorem ExtLogDomain.mul {x y : L} (hx : ExtLogDomain p x) (hy : ExtLogDomain p y) :
    ExtLogDomain p (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, k, a, hm, hxy, ha⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨m', k', b, hm', hxy', hb⟩ := hy
  have hpL : (p : L) ≠ 0 := natCast_p_ne_zero p
  refine ⟨m * m', k * m' + k' * m, a ^ m' * b ^ m, Nat.mul_pos hm hm', ?_,
    mul_mem_expBall p (pow_mem_expBall p ha m') (pow_mem_expBall p hb m)⟩
  rw [mul_pow, pow_mul x m m', hxy, mul_pow, mul_comm m m', pow_mul y m' m, hxy',
    mul_pow, ← zpow_natCast ((p : L) ^ k) m', ← zpow_mul,
    ← zpow_natCast ((p : L) ^ k') m, ← zpow_mul, zpow_add₀ hpL]
  ring

name: ExtLogDomain.prod
statement:
theorem ExtLogDomain.prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → L)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, ExtLogDomain p (f i)) : ExtLogDomain p (∏ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => exact ⟨1, 0, 1, one_pos, by rw [Finset.prod_empty, one_pow, zpow_zero, one_mul],
      inExpBall_one_sub_one p⟩
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hi]
    exact ExtLogDomain.mul p (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s))
      (ih fun j hj => hf j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))

name: extLog_prod
statement:
theorem extLog_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → L)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, ExtLogDomain p (f i)) :
    extLog p (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, extLog p (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => rw [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_empty,
      extLog_eq_padicLog p (inExpBall_one_sub_one p), padicLog_one]
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    have hdom : ∀ j ∈ s, ExtLogDomain p (f j) := fun j hj => hf j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi,
      extLog_mul p (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)) (ExtLogDomain.prod p s f hdom), ih hdom]

name: extLog_eq_zero_of_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem extLog_eq_zero_of_pow_eq_one {x : L} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hx : x ^ n = 1) : extLog p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [extLog_eq_of_witness p hn (by rw [hx, zpow_zero, one_mul])
      (inExpBall_one_sub_one p), padicLog_one, smul_zero]

name: extLog_neg
statement:
theorem extLog_neg {x : L} (hx : ExtLogDomain p x) :
    extLog p (-x) = extLog p x
proof:
:= by
  
  have hneg1 : ExtLogDomain p (-1 : L) :=
    ⟨2, 0, 1, two_pos, by rw [neg_one_sq, zpow_zero, one_mul], inExpBall_one_sub_one p⟩
  rw [show (-x : L) = (-1) * x by rw [neg_one_mul], extLog_mul p hneg1 hx,
    extLog_eq_zero_of_pow_eq_one p two_pos (neg_one_sq (R := L)), zero_add]

name: extLogDomain_of_integral_norm_one
statement:
theorem extLogDomain_of_integral_norm_one {z : L} (hz : IsIntegral ℤ z)
    (hz1 : ‖z‖ = 1) : ExtLogDomain p z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmle⟩ := exists_pow_sub_one_norm_le p hz hz1
  have hlt : ‖z ^ m - 1‖ < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt hmle (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by exact_mod_cast hp.out.one_lt))
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_pPow_pow_inExpBall p hlt
  refine ⟨m * p ^ j, 0, z ^ (m * p ^ j),
    Nat.mul_pos hm (pow_pos hp.out.pos j), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [zpow_zero, one_mul]
  · rwa [pow_mul]

name: FglobalPlus_le_Fglobal
statement: lemma FglobalPlus_le_Fglobal (n : ℕ) : FglobalPlus p n ≤ Fglobal p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [FglobalPlus, IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff]
  exact add_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ _)
    ((Fglobal p n).inv_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ _))

name: norm_le_one_of_isIntegral_int
statement:
theorem norm_le_one_of_isIntegral_int {x : ℂ_[p]} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hPmonic, hPx⟩ := hx
  by_contra h1
  push Not at h1
  set N : ℕ := P.natDegree with hNdef
  
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      (algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff i) * x ^ i = 0 := by
    rw [← Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum_range]; exact hPx
  have htop : x ^ N
      = -∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff i) * x ^ i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at hsum
    have hlead : (algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff N) * x ^ N = x ^ N := by
      rw [hNdef, hPmonic.coeff_natDegree, map_one, one_mul]
    rw [hlead, add_comm, ← eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero] at hsum
    exact hsum
  
  have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := lt_trans one_pos h1
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with hN0 | hNpos
  · 
    rw [hN0, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, neg_zero, pow_zero] at htop
    exact absurd htop one_ne_zero
  
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hile⟩ := IsUltrametricDist.exists_norm_finsetSum_le_of_nonempty
    (t := Finset.range N) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.2 hNpos⟩
    (fun i => (algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff i) * x ^ i)
  have hilt : i < N := Finset.mem_range.1 hi
  have hcoeff : ‖(algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff i)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [show (algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff i) = ((P.coeff i : ℤ) : ℂ_[p]) by
      simp [algebraMap_int_eq]]
    exact IsUltrametricDist.norm_intCast_le_one ℂ_[p] _
  have hterm : ‖(algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff i) * x ^ i‖ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (N - 1) := by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
    calc ‖(algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff i)‖ * ‖x‖ ^ i
        ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ ^ i := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff (by positivity)
      _ = ‖x‖ ^ i := one_mul _
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (N - 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ h1.le (by omega)
  have hxNbound : ‖x‖ ^ N ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (N - 1) := by
    calc ‖x‖ ^ N = ‖x ^ N‖ := (norm_pow x N).symm
      _ = ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff i) * x ^ i‖ := by
          rw [htop, norm_neg]
      _ ≤ ‖(algebraMap ℤ ℂ_[p]) (P.coeff i) * x ^ i‖ := hile
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (N - 1) := hterm
  have hlt : ‖x‖ ^ (N - 1) < ‖x‖ ^ N :=
    pow_lt_pow_right₀ h1 (by omega)
  exact absurd (lt_of_le_of_lt hxNbound hlt) (lt_irrefl _)

name: Fglobal_le_K
statement: lemma Fglobal_le_K {n : ℕ} {x : ℂ_[p]} (hx : x ∈ Fglobal p n) : x ∈ K p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fglobal] at hx
  induction hx using IntermediateField.adjoin_induction with
  | mem y hy => obtain rfl := hy; exact zetaSys_mem_K p n
  | algebraMap q =>
      rw [eq_ratCast (algebraMap ℚ ℂ_[p]) q]
      exact SubfieldClass.ratCast_mem (K p n) q
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add_mem hy hz
  | inv y _ hy => exact (K p n).inv_mem hy
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz => exact mul_mem hy hz

name: globalUnits_le_localUnits
statement: theorem globalUnits_le_localUnits (n : ℕ) : globalUnits p n ≤ localUnits p n
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  rw [mem_localUnits_iff]
  obtain ⟨hF, hint, hintinv⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [O, Subring.mem_inf]
    exact ⟨Fglobal_le_K p hF, norm_le_one_of_isIntegral_int p hint⟩
  · rw [O, Subring.mem_inf]
    refine ⟨Fglobal_le_K p ?_, norm_le_one_of_isIntegral_int p hintinv⟩
    rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
    exact (Fglobal p n).inv_mem hF

name: cycloUnits_le_globalUnits
statement: lemma cycloUnits_le_globalUnits (n : ℕ) : cycloUnits p n ≤ globalUnits p n
proof:
:=
  inf_le_right

name: cycloTower1_le_unitsTower1
statement: lemma cycloTower1_le_unitsTower1 : cycloTower1 p ≤ unitsTower1 p
proof:
:=
  fun _ hu n hn => (Subgroup.mem_inf.1 (hu n hn)).2

name: zetaSys_isIntegral
statement: private theorem zetaSys_isIntegral (n : ℕ) : IsIntegral ℤ (zetaSys p n)
proof:
:=
  (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).isIntegral (pow_pos hp.out.pos n)

name: cycloUnit_eq_geomSum
statement:
private theorem cycloUnit_eq_geomSum {a : ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    cycloUnit p a n = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, zetaSys p n ^ i
proof:
:= by
  have hne : zetaSys p n - 1 ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero_of_ne ((zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).ne_one (one_lt_pow₀ hp.out.one_lt (by omega)))
  rw [cycloUnit, div_eq_iff hne, geom_sum_mul]

name: isIntegral_cycloUnit
statement:
theorem isIntegral_cycloUnit {a : ℕ} (_ha : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ a) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (cycloUnit p a n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycloUnit_eq_geomSum p hn]
  exact IsIntegral.sum _ fun i _ => (zetaSys_isIntegral p n).pow i

name: orderOf_zetaSys
statement: private theorem orderOf_zetaSys (n : ℕ) : orderOf (zetaSys p n) = p ^ n
proof:
:=
  ((zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).eq_orderOf).symm

name: inv_cycloUnit_eq_geomSum
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime a (p ^ n) :=
    Nat.Coprime.pow_right _ ((hp.out.coprime_iff_not_dvd).2 ha).symm
  have hpn1 : 1 < p ^ n := one_lt_pow₀ hp.out.one_lt (by omega)
  obtain ⟨a', _, haa'⟩ := Nat.exists_mul_mod_eq_one_of_coprime hcop hpn1
  refine ⟨a', ?_⟩
  
  have hpow : zetaSys p n ^ (a * a') = zetaSys p n := by
    rw [← pow_mod_orderOf, orderOf_zetaSys, haa', pow_one]
  
  have hgeom : (zetaSys p n ^ a - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range a', (zetaSys p n ^ a) ^ i
      = zetaSys p n - 1 := by
    rw [mul_comm, geom_sum_mul, ← pow_mul, hpow]
  
  have hden1 : zetaSys p n - 1 ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero_of_ne ((zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).ne_one hpn1)
  have hden2 : zetaSys p n ^ a - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul] at hgeom
    exact hden1 hgeom.symm
  
  rw [cycloUnit, inv_div, div_eq_iff hden2, mul_comm, hgeom]

name: isIntegral_inv_cycloUnit
statement:
theorem isIntegral_inv_cycloUnit {a : ℕ} (ha : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ a) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (cycloUnit p a n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := inv_cycloUnit_eq_geomSum p ha hn
  rw [ha']
  exact IsIntegral.sum _ fun i _ => ((zetaSys_isIntegral p n).pow a).pow i

name: norm_primitiveRoot_eq_one'
statement:
private theorem norm_primitiveRoot_eq_one' {n : ℕ} {ξ : ℂ_[p]}
    (hξ : IsPrimitiveRoot ξ (p ^ n)) : ‖ξ‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ‖ξ‖ ^ (p ^ n) = 1 := by rw [← norm_pow, hξ.pow_eq_one, norm_one]
  have hne : p ^ n ≠ 0 := (pow_pos hp.out.pos n).ne'
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · by_contra h; rw [not_le] at h; exact absurd h1 (one_lt_pow₀ h hne).ne'
  · by_contra h; rw [not_le] at h; exact absurd h1 (pow_lt_one₀ (norm_nonneg ξ) h hne).ne

name: norm_pow_sub_one_le'
statement:
private theorem norm_pow_sub_one_le' {ξ : ℂ_[p]} (hξ1 : ‖ξ‖ = 1) (c : ℕ) :
    ‖ξ ^ c - 1‖ ≤ ‖ξ - 1‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ξ ^ c - 1 = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range c, ξ ^ i) * (ξ - 1) from (geom_sum_mul ξ c).symm,
    norm_mul]
  have hgeom : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range c, ξ ^ i‖ ≤ 1 :=
    IsUltrametricDist.norm_sum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg zero_le_one
      (fun i _ => by rw [norm_pow, hξ1, one_pow])
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (ξ - 1), hgeom]

name: norm_zetaSys_pow_sub_one_lt_one
statement:
private theorem norm_zetaSys_pow_sub_one_lt_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (i : ℕ) :
    ‖zetaSys p n ^ i - 1‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ‖zetaSys p n‖ = 1 := norm_primitiveRoot_eq_one' p (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n)
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_pow_sub_one_le' p h1 i) ?_
  have := norm_pi_lt_one p hn
  rwa [pi] at this

name: norm_natCast_sub_one_lt_one_of_modEq
statement:
private theorem norm_natCast_sub_one_lt_one_of_modEq {a : ℕ} (ha1 : a ≡ 1 [MOD p]) :
    ‖(a : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hple : 1 ≤ a := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with h0 | h0
    · subst h0
      have hdvd : p ∣ 1 := Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.1 ha1.symm
      exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd one_pos hdvd) (by simpa using hp.out.one_lt)
    · exact h0
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : p ∣ a - 1 := (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hple).1 ha1.symm
  have hcast : (a : ℂ_[p]) - 1 = (p : ℂ_[p]) * (k : ℂ_[p]) := by
    have : ((a - 1 : ℕ) : ℂ_[p]) = (a : ℂ_[p]) - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hple, Nat.cast_one]
    rw [← this, hk, Nat.cast_mul]
  have hpnorm : ‖(p : ℂ_[p])‖ = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [show ((p : ℂ_[p])) = algebraMap ℚ_[p] ℂ_[p] (p : ℚ_[p]) by rw [map_natCast],
      norm_algebraMap', Padic.norm_p]
  rw [hcast, norm_mul, hpnorm]
  have hk1 : ‖(k : ℂ_[p])‖ ≤ 1 := IsUltrametricDist.norm_natCast_le_one ℂ_[p] k
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.out.one_lt
  calc (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖(k : ℂ_[p])‖ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk1 (by positivity)
    _ = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := mul_one _
    _ < 1 := by rw [inv_lt_one_iff₀]; right; exact hp1

name: norm_cycloUnit_sub_one_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  
  have hca : cycloUnit p a n - (a : ℂ_[p]) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, (zetaSys p n ^ i - 1) := by
    rw [cycloUnit_eq_geomSum p hn, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  
  have hsum : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, (zetaSys p n ^ i - 1)‖ < 1 := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (IsUltrametricDist.norm_sum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg
      (norm_nonneg (pi p n)) (fun i _ => ?_)) (norm_pi_lt_one p hn)
    have h1 : ‖zetaSys p n‖ = 1 := norm_primitiveRoot_eq_one' p (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n)
    have := norm_pow_sub_one_le' p h1 i
    rwa [pi]
  
  have hsplit : cycloUnit p a n - 1
      = (cycloUnit p a n - (a : ℂ_[p])) + ((a : ℂ_[p]) - 1) := by ring
  rw [hsplit]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _) (max_lt ?_ ?_)
  · rw [hca]; exact hsum
  · exact norm_natCast_sub_one_lt_one_of_modEq p ha1

name: cycloUnit_mem_Fglobal
statement:
private theorem cycloUnit_mem_Fglobal {a : ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    cycloUnit p a n ∈ Fglobal p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycloUnit_eq_geomSum p hn]
  exact sum_mem fun i _ => pow_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ _) i

name: cyclo_elems_mem_globalUnits
proof:
:= by
  have hval : ((cyclo p ha hp2).elems n : ℂ_[p]) = cycloUnit p a n := by
    change ((if hn : 1 ≤ n then Units.mk0 (cycloUnit p a n)
      (cycloUnit_ne_zero p ha hn) else 1 : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = _
    rw [dif_pos hn, Units.val_mk0]
  have hinv : ((((cyclo p ha hp2).elems n)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = (cycloUnit p a n)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, hval]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hval]; exact cycloUnit_mem_Fglobal p hn
  · rw [hval]; exact isIntegral_cycloUnit p ha hn
  · rw [hinv]; exact isIntegral_inv_cycloUnit p ha hn

name: cyclo_elems_mem_cycloUnits
statement:
theorem cyclo_elems_mem_cycloUnits {a : ℕ} (ha : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ a) (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (cyclo p ha hp2).elems n ∈ cycloUnits p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycloUnits, Subgroup.mem_inf]
  refine ⟨?_, cyclo_elems_mem_globalUnits p ha hp2 hn⟩
  
  have hpn1 : 1 < p ^ n := one_lt_pow₀ hp.out.one_lt (by omega)
  have hne1 : zetaSys p n - 1 ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero_of_ne ((zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).ne_one hpn1)
  
  have hpndvd : ¬ p ^ n ∣ a := fun h => ha (dvd_trans (dvd_pow_self p (by omega)) h)
  have hmod_pos : 1 ≤ a % p ^ n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (a % p ^ n) with h0 | h0
    · exact absurd (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0) hpndvd
    · exact h0
  have hmodlt0 : a % p ^ n < p ^ n := Nat.mod_lt _ (by positivity)
  have hmod_lt : a % p ^ n ≤ p ^ n - 1 := by omega
  have hne2 : zetaSys p n ^ (a % p ^ n) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    refine sub_ne_zero_of_ne fun h => ?_
    have hord : p ^ n ∣ a % p ^ n := by
      have := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h
      rwa [orderOf_zetaSys] at this
    exact absurd (Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hord hmodlt0) (by omega)
  set num : ℂ_[p]ˣ := Units.mk0 (zetaSys p n ^ (a % p ^ n) - 1) hne2 with hnumdef
  set den : ℂ_[p]ˣ := Units.mk0 (zetaSys p n - 1) hne1 with hdendef
  have hnummem : num ∈ cycloGenSet p n :=
    Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a % p ^ n, hmod_pos, hmod_lt, by rw [hnumdef, Units.val_mk0]⟩)
  have hdenmem : den ∈ cycloGenSet p n :=
    Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, le_rfl, Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hpn1,
      by rw [hdendef, Units.val_mk0, pow_one]⟩)
  have hpowred : zetaSys p n ^ a = zetaSys p n ^ (a % p ^ n) := by
    rw [← orderOf_zetaSys p n, pow_mod_orderOf]
  have hword : (cyclo p ha hp2).elems n = num * den⁻¹ := by
    refine Units.ext ?_
    change ((if hn : 1 ≤ n then Units.mk0 (cycloUnit p a n)
      (cycloUnit_ne_zero p ha hn) else 1 : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = _
    rw [dif_pos hn, Units.val_mk0, Units.val_mul,
      show ((den⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = (zetaSys p n - 1)⁻¹ from rfl, hnumdef, Units.val_mk0,
      cycloUnit, hpowred, div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [hword]
  exact mul_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure hnummem)
    (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (Subgroup.subset_closure hdenmem))

name: cyclo_mem_cycloTower1
statement:
theorem cyclo_mem_cycloTower1 {a : ℕ} (ha : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ a) (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    (ha1 : a ≡ 1 [MOD p]) :
    cyclo p ha hp2 ∈ cycloTower1 p
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  
  have hmemD : (cyclo p ha hp2).elems n ∈ cycloUnits p n :=
    cyclo_elems_mem_cycloUnits p ha hp2 hn
  have hmemloc : (cyclo p ha hp2).elems n ∈ localUnits p n :=
    globalUnits_le_localUnits p n (cycloUnits_le_globalUnits p n hmemD)
  
  have hval : ((cyclo p ha hp2).elems n : ℂ_[p]) = cycloUnit p a n := by
    change ((if hn : 1 ≤ n then Units.mk0 (cycloUnit p a n)
      (cycloUnit_ne_zero p ha hn) else 1 : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = _
    rw [dif_pos hn, Units.val_mk0]
  rw [cycloClosureOne, Subgroup.mem_inf]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [cycloClosure, Subgroup.mem_inf]
    exact ⟨Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _ hmemD, hmemloc⟩
  · rw [mem_localUnitsOne_iff]
    refine ⟨hmemloc, ?_⟩
    rw [hval]
    exact norm_cycloUnit_sub_one_lt_one p ha hn ha1

name: cyclo_mem_unitsTower1
statement:
theorem cyclo_mem_unitsTower1 {a : ℕ} (ha : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ a) (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    (ha1 : a ≡ 1 [MOD p]) :
    cyclo p ha hp2 ∈ unitsTower1 p
proof:
:=
  cycloTower1_le_unitsTower1 p (cyclo_mem_cycloTower1 p ha hp2 ha1)

name: zetaSys_ne_zero'
statement: private theorem zetaSys_ne_zero' {n : ℕ} : zetaSys p n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by
    rw [norm_primitiveRoot_eq_one' p (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n)]; exact one_ne_zero)

name: zetaSysU_val
statement: private theorem zetaSysU_val {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (zetaSysU p hn : ℂ_[p]) = zetaSys p n
proof:
:=
  Units.val_mk0 _

name: norm_zetaSys_sub_one_lt_one'
statement:
private theorem norm_zetaSys_sub_one_lt_one' {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ‖zetaSys p n - 1‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have := norm_pi_lt_one p hn; rwa [pi] at this

name: zetaSysU_pow_mem_cycloUnits
statement:
private theorem zetaSysU_pow_mem_cycloUnits {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) :
    zetaSysU p hn ^ k ∈ cycloUnits p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycloUnits, Subgroup.mem_inf]
  have hgen : zetaSysU p hn ∈ cycloGenSet p n := Or.inl (zetaSysU_val p hn)
  refine ⟨Subgroup.pow_mem _ (Subgroup.subset_closure hgen) k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, zetaSysU_val]
    exact pow_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ _) k
  · 
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, zetaSysU_val]
    exact ((zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).isIntegral (pow_pos hp.out.pos n)).pow k
  · 
    rw [show (((zetaSysU p hn ^ k)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = ((zetaSys p n)⁻¹) ^ k from by
      rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, zetaSysU_val, inv_pow]]
    refine IsIntegral.pow ?_ k
    
    rw [show (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ = (zetaSys p n) ^ (p ^ n - 1) from ?_]
    · exact ((zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).isIntegral (pow_pos hp.out.pos n)).pow _
    · refine inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left ?_
      rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hp.out.pos),
        (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).pow_eq_one]

name: zetaSysU_mem_localUnitsOne
statement:
private theorem zetaSysU_mem_localUnitsOne {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    zetaSysU p hn ∈ localUnitsOne p n
proof:
:= by
  have hξ1 : ‖zetaSys p n‖ = 1 := norm_primitiveRoot_eq_one' p (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n)
  have hmemO : (zetaSysU p hn : ℂ_[p]) ∈ O p n := by
    rw [zetaSysU_val, O, Subring.mem_inf]; exact ⟨zetaSys_mem_K p n, le_of_eq hξ1⟩
  have hinvval : (((zetaSysU p hn)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, zetaSysU_val]
  have hinvnorm : ‖(zetaSys p n)⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 := le_of_eq (by rw [norm_inv, hξ1, inv_one])
  have hmemOinv : (((zetaSysU p hn)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) ∈ O p n := by
    rw [hinvval, O, Subring.mem_inf]
    exact ⟨(K p n).inv_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n), hinvnorm⟩
  rw [mem_localUnitsOne_iff]
  exact ⟨⟨hmemO, hmemOinv⟩, by rw [zetaSysU_val]; exact norm_zetaSys_sub_one_lt_one' p hn⟩

name: zpPow_zetaSys_mem_cycloClosureOne
statement:
theorem zpPow_zetaSys_mem_cycloClosureOne {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : ℤ_[p])
    {x : ℂ_[p]ˣ} (hx : (x : ℂ_[p]) = zpPow p (zetaSys p n) a) :
    x ∈ cycloClosureOne p n
proof:
:= by
  have hz1 : ‖zetaSys p n - 1‖ < 1 := norm_zetaSys_sub_one_lt_one' p hn
  
  have hcont : Continuous (zpPow p (zetaSys p n)) := by
    have h : zpPow p (zetaSys p n) = (PadicInt.addChar_of_value_at_one (zetaSys p n - 1)
        (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_iff_norm_lt_one.mpr hz1) : ℤ_[p] → ℂ_[p]) := by
      funext c; rw [zpPow, dif_pos (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_iff_norm_lt_one.mpr hz1)]
    rw [h]; exact PadicInt.continuous_addChar_of_value_at_one _
  
  set F : ℤ_[p] → ℂ_[p]ˣ := fun c => ⟨zpPow p (zetaSys p n) c, zpPow p (zetaSys p n) (-c),
    by rw [← zpPow_add p hz1, add_neg_cancel, show (0 : ℤ_[p]) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) by norm_cast,
      zpPow_natCast p hz1, pow_zero],
    by rw [← zpPow_add p hz1, neg_add_cancel, show (0 : ℤ_[p]) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) by norm_cast,
      zpPow_natCast p hz1, pow_zero]⟩ with hF
  have hFval : ∀ c, (F c : ℂ_[p]) = zpPow p (zetaSys p n) c := fun _ => rfl
  have hFcont : Continuous F :=
    Units.continuous_iff.2 ⟨hcont, hcont.comp continuous_neg⟩
  
  have hFnat : ∀ k : ℕ, F (k : ℤ_[p]) = zetaSysU p hn ^ k := by
    intro k
    refine Units.ext ?_
    rw [hFval, zpPow_natCast p hz1, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, zetaSysU_val]
  
  have hxF : x = F a := Units.ext (by rw [hFval]; exact hx)
  have hclos : x ∈ (cycloUnits p n).topologicalClosure := by
    
    have hrange : Set.range F ⊆ closure (cycloUnits p n : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by
      
      have h1 : Set.range F = F '' (closure (Set.range (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ_[p]))) := by
        rw [PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.closure_range, Set.image_univ]
      rw [h1]
      refine (image_closure_subset_closure_image hFcont).trans (closure_mono ?_)
      rw [← Set.range_comp]
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      show (F ∘ Nat.cast) k ∈ (cycloUnits p n : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ)
      rw [Function.comp_apply, hFnat k]
      exact zetaSysU_pow_mem_cycloUnits p hn k
    have : x ∈ closure (cycloUnits p n : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by rw [hxF]; exact hrange ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rwa [← Subgroup.topologicalClosure_coe, SetLike.mem_coe] at this
  
  obtain ⟨v, hvval, hvmem⟩ := zpPow_mem_localUnitsOne p (zetaSysU_mem_localUnitsOne p hn) a
  have hxv : x = v := Units.ext (by rw [hx, hvval, zetaSysU_val])
  rw [cycloClosureOne, Subgroup.mem_inf, cycloClosure, Subgroup.mem_inf]
  exact ⟨⟨hclos, by rw [hxv]; exact hvmem.1⟩, by rw [hxv]; exact hvmem⟩

name: zpPow_mem_cycloUnits_topologicalClosure
statement:
theorem zpPow_mem_cycloUnits_topologicalClosure {n : ℕ} {y : ℂ_[p]ˣ}
    (hyc : ‖(y : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1) (hyclos : y ∈ (cycloUnits p n).topologicalClosure)
    (a : ℤ_[p]) {x : ℂ_[p]ˣ} (hx : (x : ℂ_[p]) = zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) a) :
    x ∈ (cycloUnits p n).topologicalClosure
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcont : Continuous (zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p])) := by
    have h : zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) = (PadicInt.addChar_of_value_at_one ((y : ℂ_[p]) - 1)
        (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_iff_norm_lt_one.mpr hyc) : ℤ_[p] → ℂ_[p]) := by
      funext c; rw [zpPow, dif_pos (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_iff_norm_lt_one.mpr hyc)]
    rw [h]; exact PadicInt.continuous_addChar_of_value_at_one _
  
  set F : ℤ_[p] → ℂ_[p]ˣ := fun c => ⟨zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) c, zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) (-c),
    by rw [← zpPow_add p hyc, add_neg_cancel, show (0 : ℤ_[p]) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) by norm_cast,
      zpPow_natCast p hyc, pow_zero],
    by rw [← zpPow_add p hyc, neg_add_cancel, show (0 : ℤ_[p]) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) by norm_cast,
      zpPow_natCast p hyc, pow_zero]⟩ with hF
  have hFval : ∀ c, (F c : ℂ_[p]) = zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) c := fun _ => rfl
  have hFcont : Continuous F := Units.continuous_iff.2 ⟨hcont, hcont.comp continuous_neg⟩
  have hFnat : ∀ k : ℕ, F (k : ℤ_[p]) = y ^ k := by
    intro k; refine Units.ext ?_
    rw [hFval, zpPow_natCast p hyc, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
  have hxF : x = F a := Units.ext (by rw [hFval]; exact hx)
  
  have hrange : Set.range F ⊆ closure ((cycloUnits p n).topologicalClosure : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by
    have h1 : Set.range F = F '' (closure (Set.range (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ_[p]))) := by
      rw [PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.closure_range, Set.image_univ]
    rw [h1]
    refine (image_closure_subset_closure_image hFcont).trans (closure_mono ?_)
    rw [← Set.range_comp]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    show (F ∘ Nat.cast) k ∈ ((cycloUnits p n).topologicalClosure : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ)
    rw [Function.comp_apply, hFnat k]
    exact pow_mem hyclos k
  have hxmem : x ∈ closure ((cycloUnits p n).topologicalClosure : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by
    rw [hxF]; exact hrange ⟨a, rfl⟩
  rwa [(Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).closure_eq, SetLike.mem_coe] at hxmem

name: mem_cycloClosureOne_of_pow_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hgc : ‖(g : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1 := ((mem_localUnitsOne_iff p).1 hg).2
  
  have hgpowclos : g ^ (p - 1) ∈ (cycloUnits p n).topologicalClosure := by
    rw [cycloClosureOne, Subgroup.mem_inf, cycloClosure, Subgroup.mem_inf] at hgpow
    exact hgpow.1.1
  
  have hunit : IsUnit ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) :=
    PadicInt.isUnit_iff.mpr PadicInt.norm_natCast_p_sub_one
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hunit.exists_left_inv
  
  have hgeq : (g : ℂ_[p]) = zpPow p ((g ^ (p - 1) : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) c := by
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
    have hpow : (g : ℂ_[p]) ^ (p - 1) = zpPow p (g : ℂ_[p]) ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) :=
      (zpPow_natCast p hgc (p - 1)).symm
    rw [hpow, ← zpPow_mul p hgc, mul_comm, hc,
      show (1 : ℤ_[p]) = ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) by norm_cast, zpPow_natCast p hgc, pow_one]
  have hypowc : ‖((g ^ (p - 1) : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← zpPow_natCast p hgc]
    exact norm_zpPow_sub_one_lt_one p hgc _
  
  rw [cycloClosureOne, Subgroup.mem_inf, cycloClosure, Subgroup.mem_inf]
  exact ⟨⟨zpPow_mem_cycloUnits_topologicalClosure p hypowc hgpowclos c hgeq,
    ((mem_localUnitsOne_iff p).1 hg).1⟩, hg⟩

name: odd_moment_factor_eq_zero
statement:
theorem odd_moment_factor_eq_zero {k : ℕ} (hk : Odd k) :
    (1 - (p : ℚ_[p]) ^ (k - 1)) * ((zetaNeg (k - 1) : ℚ) : ℚ_[p]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hk1 := eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hk.pos.ne')
  · 
    simp
  · 
    have hzero : zetaNeg (k - 1) = 0 := by
      rw [zetaNeg, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk.pos, bernoulli_eq_zero_of_odd hk hk1, mul_zero,
        zero_div]
    rw [hzero, Rat.cast_zero, mul_zero]

name: padicZeta_odd_moment_eq_zero
statement:
theorem padicZeta_odd_moment_eq_zero (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (b : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {k : ℕ} (hk : Odd k)
    (ν : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ)
    (hν : algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) (dirac p b - 1) * padicZeta p hp2
      = algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) ν) :
    ν (unitsPowCM p k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hm := padicZeta_moments p hp2 b hk.pos ν hν
  rw [mul_assoc, odd_moment_factor_eq_zero p hk, mul_zero] at hm
  
  refine Subtype.coe_injective ?_
  change ((ν (unitsPowCM p k) : ℤ_[p]) : ℚ_[p]) = ((0 : ℤ_[p]) : ℚ_[p])
  rw [hm]
  norm_num

name: dirac_neg_one_sub_one_mul_padicZeta
statement:
theorem dirac_neg_one_sub_one_mul_padicZeta (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) (dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) - 1)
        * padicZeta p hp2
      = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := padicZeta_isPseudoMeasure p hp2 (-1)
  have hzero : ν = 0 := by
    refine eq_zero_of_forall_unitsPowCM_eq_zero p ν fun k hk => ?_
    have hm := padicZeta_moments p hp2 (-1) hk ν hν
    have hb : ((-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) : ℚ_[p]) = -1 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hb] at hm
    refine Subtype.coe_injective ?_
    change ((ν (unitsPowCM p k) : ℤ_[p]) : ℚ_[p]) = ((0 : ℤ_[p]) : ℚ_[p])
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd k with he | ho
    · 
      rw [he.neg_one_pow, sub_self, zero_mul, zero_mul] at hm
      rw [hm]; norm_num
    · 
      rw [mul_assoc, odd_moment_factor_eq_zero p ho, mul_zero] at hm
      rw [hm]; norm_num
  rw [hzero, map_zero] at hν
  exact hν

name: padicZeta_witness_neg
statement:
theorem padicZeta_witness_neg (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (g : ℤ_[p]ˣ)
    {ν ν' : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ}
    (hν : algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) (dirac p g - 1) * padicZeta p hp2
      = algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) ν)
    (hν' : algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) (dirac p (-g) - 1)
        * padicZeta p hp2
      = algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) ν') :
    ν = ν'
proof:
:= by
  
  have hfac : (dirac p (-g) - dirac p g : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ)
      = dirac p g * (dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) - 1) := by
    rw [mul_sub, units_dirac_mul_dirac, mul_one, mul_neg_one]
  have hkey : algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) ν'
      = algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) ν := by
    have hsub : algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) ν'
        - algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) ν = 0 := by
      rw [← hν', ← hν, ← sub_mul]
      have : algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) (dirac p (-g) - 1)
          - algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) (dirac p g - 1)
          = algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p)
              (dirac p g) * algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p)
                (dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) - 1) := by
        rw [← map_mul, ← hfac, ← map_sub]
        ring_nf
      rw [this, mul_assoc, dirac_neg_one_sub_one_mul_padicZeta p hp2, mul_zero]
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at hsub
    exact hsub
  exact (IsFractionRing.injective (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) hkey).symm

name: dirac_mk_sub_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem dirac_mk_sub_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {a : ℤ_[p]ˣ}
    (ha : (dirac p a - 1 : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ)
      ∈ nonZeroDivisors (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ)) :
    (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk a : GPlus p) - 1 : PadicMeasure p (GPlus p))
      ∈ nonZeroDivisors (PadicMeasure p (GPlus p))
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff]
  
  have key : ∀ ν : PadicMeasure p (GPlus p),
      ν * (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk a : GPlus p) - 1) = 0 → ν = 0 := by
    intro ν hν
    set μ := plusSection p hp2 ν with hμ
    
    have hproj : projPlus p (μ * (dirac p a - 1))
        = ν * (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk a : GPlus p) - 1) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_sub, map_one, projPlus_dirac, hμ, projPlus_plusSection p hp2]
    rw [hν] at hproj
    
    have hmem_minus : μ * (dirac p a - 1) ∈ minusPart p :=
      (projPlus_eq_zero_iff p hp2).1 hproj
    
    have hmem_plus : μ * (dirac p a - 1) ∈ plusPart p := by
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact mul_mem_plusPart p (plusSection_mem_plusPart p hp2 ν)
    
    have hzero : μ * (dirac p a - 1) = 0 :=
      (Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (isCompl_plusPart_minusPart p hp2).disjoint)
        _ hmem_plus hmem_minus
    
    have hμ0 : μ = 0 := (mul_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors_eq_zero_iff ha).1 hzero
    rw [← projPlus_plusSection p hp2 ν, ← hμ, hμ0, map_zero]
  
  exact ⟨fun x hx => key x (by rw [mul_comm x]; exact hx), key⟩

name: projPlus_padicZeta_witness
statement:
theorem projPlus_padicZeta_witness (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (g : ℤ_[p]ˣ)
    {ν : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ}
    (hν : algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) (dirac p g - 1) * padicZeta p hp2
      = algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) ν) :
    toQPlus p (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk g : GPlus p) - 1) * padicZetaPlus p hp2
      = toQPlus p (projPlus p ν)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set m := (exists_nat_topological_generator p hp2).choose with hm
  set u := (exists_nat_topological_generator p hp2).choose_spec.choose with hu
  
  have hspec : algebraMap _ (QuotientField p) (dirac p u - 1) * padicZeta p hp2
      = algebraMap _ _ (zetaNum p m) := by
    rw [padicZeta]
    exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec' (QuotientField p) _ _
  
  have hkey : (dirac p u - 1) * ν = (dirac p g - 1) * zetaNum p m := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p)
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← hν, ← hspec]
    ring
  
  have hkeyP : (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk g : GPlus p) - 1)
        * projPlus p (zetaNum p m)
      = (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk u : GPlus p) - 1) * projPlus p ν := by
    have := congrArg (projPlus p) hkey
    simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_one, projPlus_dirac] at this
    exact this.symm
  
  
  set c : nonZeroDivisors (PadicMeasure p (GPlus p)) :=
    ⟨dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk u : GPlus p) - 1,
      dirac_mk_sub_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors p hp2
        (dirac_sub_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors p
          (topGen_pow_ne_one p
            (exists_nat_topological_generator p hp2).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.2))⟩ with hc
  
  have hzp : padicZetaPlus p hp2
      = IsLocalization.mk' (QuotientFieldPlus p) (projPlus p (zetaNum p m)) c := rfl
  
  have hcunit : IsUnit (algebraMap (PadicMeasure p (GPlus p)) (QuotientFieldPlus p) (c : _)) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units (QuotientFieldPlus p) c
  
  rw [hzp, toQPlus, ← hcunit.mul_left_inj, mul_assoc, IsLocalization.mk'_spec,
    ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
  
  congr 1
  rw [hkeyP]
  ring

name: isPlusPseudoMeasure_padicZetaPlus
statement:
theorem isPlusPseudoMeasure_padicZetaPlus (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    IsPlusPseudoMeasure p (padicZetaPlus p hp2)
proof:
:= by
  
  intro gPlus
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective gPlus
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := padicZeta_isPseudoMeasure p hp2 g
  exact ⟨projPlus p ν, projPlus_padicZeta_witness p hp2 g hν⟩

name: mem_zetaIdeal_iff
statement:
lemma mem_zetaIdeal_iff (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {x : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ} :
    x ∈ zetaIdeal p hp2 ↔ ∃ l ∈ augmentationIdeal p (G := ℤ_[p]ˣ),
      algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) x
        = algebraMap (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) l * padicZeta p hp2
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: zetaIdeal_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  
  have hbmem : (dirac p b - 1 : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) ∈ augmentationIdeal p := by
    rw [augmentationIdeal, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, map_one,
      show deg p (dirac p b) = 1 from rfl, sub_self]
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    rintro x ⟨l, hl, he⟩
    rw [augmentationIdeal_eq_span p hb, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hl
    obtain ⟨ρ, rfl⟩ := hl
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    
    refine ⟨ρ, IsFractionRing.injective (PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (QuotientField p) ?_⟩
    rw [he, map_mul, map_mul, ← hν]
    ring
  · 
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact ⟨dirac p b - 1, hbmem, hν.symm⟩

name: augmentationIdealPlus_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := projPlus_surjective p hp2 y
    
    have hxmem : x ∈ augmentationIdeal p (G := ℤ_[p]ˣ) := by
      rw [augmentationIdeal, RingHom.mem_ker, ← deg_projPlus p x]
      exact RingHom.mem_ker.1 hy
    rw [augmentationIdeal_eq_span p ha, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hxmem
    obtain ⟨ρ, rfl⟩ := hxmem
    
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact ⟨projPlus p ρ, by rw [map_mul, map_sub, map_one, projPlus_dirac]⟩
  · 
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    change (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk a : GPlus p) - 1 : PadicMeasure p (GPlus p))
      ∈ augmentationIdeal p
    rw [augmentationIdeal, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, map_one,
      show deg p (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk a : GPlus p)) = 1 from rfl, sub_self]

name: mem_zetaIdealPlus_iff
statement:
lemma mem_zetaIdealPlus_iff (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {x : PadicMeasure p (GPlus p)} :
    x ∈ zetaIdealPlus p hp2 ↔ ∃ l ∈ augmentationIdeal p (G := GPlus p),
      toQPlus p x = toQPlus p l * padicZetaPlus p hp2
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: zetaIdealPlus_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  
  have hwit : toQPlus p (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk a : GPlus p) - 1) * padicZetaPlus p hp2
      = toQPlus p (projPlus p ν) := projPlus_padicZeta_witness p hp2 a hν
  
  have hamem : (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk a : GPlus p) - 1 : PadicMeasure p (GPlus p))
      ∈ augmentationIdeal p (G := GPlus p) := by
    rw [augmentationIdeal, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, map_one,
      show deg p (dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk a : GPlus p)) = 1 from rfl, sub_self]
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    rintro x ⟨l, hl, he⟩
    rw [augmentationIdealPlus_eq_span p hp2 ha, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hl
    obtain ⟨ρ, rfl⟩ := hl
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    refine ⟨ρ, IsFractionRing.injective (PadicMeasure p (GPlus p)) (QuotientFieldPlus p) ?_⟩
    
    change toQPlus p x = toQPlus p (projPlus p ν * ρ)
    rw [he, map_mul, map_mul, mul_right_comm, hwit]
  · 
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact ⟨dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk a : GPlus p) - 1, hamem, hwit.symm⟩

name: mem_localUnits_iff
statement:
lemma mem_localUnits_iff {n : ℕ} {u : ℂ_[p]ˣ} :
    u ∈ localUnits p n
      ↔ (u : ℂ_[p]) ∈ O p n ∧ ((u⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) ∈ O p n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: norm_eq_one_of_mem_localUnits
statement:
lemma norm_eq_one_of_mem_localUnits {n : ℕ} {u : ℂ_[p]ˣ} (hu : u ∈ localUnits p n) :
    ‖(u : ℂ_[p])‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hu1 : ‖(u : ℂ_[p])‖ ≤ 1 := (Subring.mem_inf.1 hu.1).2
  have hu2 : ‖((u⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])‖ ≤ 1 := (Subring.mem_inf.1 hu.2).2
  have hprod : ‖(u : ℂ_[p])‖ * ‖((u⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])‖ = 1 := by
    rw [← norm_mul, Units.mul_inv, norm_one]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (u : ℂ_[p]), norm_nonneg ((u⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])]

name: mem_localUnitsOne_iff
statement:
lemma mem_localUnitsOne_iff {n : ℕ} {u : ℂ_[p]ˣ} :
    u ∈ localUnitsOne p n ↔ u ∈ localUnits p n ∧ ‖(u : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: KPlus_le_K
statement: lemma KPlus_le_K (n : ℕ) : KPlus p n ≤ K p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [KPlus, IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff]
  exact add_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n) ((K p n).inv_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n))

name: smul_cp_eq
statement: theorem smul_cp_eq (c : ℤ_[p]) (x : ℂ_[p]) : c • x = toCp p c * x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]; congr 1

name: tendsto_pow_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
private theorem tendsto_pow_of_norm_lt_one {y : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) :
    Tendsto ((y - 1) ^ ·) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_iff_norm_lt_one.mpr hy

name: zpPow_def
proof:
:= by
  rw [zpPow, dif_pos (tendsto_pow_of_norm_lt_one p hy)]

name: zpPow_natCast
statement:
theorem zpPow_natCast {y : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) (k : ℕ) :
    zpPow p y (k : ℤ_[p]) = y ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [zpPow_def p hy]
  change PadicInt.mahlerSeries ((y - 1) ^ ·) (k : ℤ_[p]) = _
  rw [show y ^ k = ((y - 1) + 1) ^ k by rw [sub_add_cancel],
    PadicInt.mahlerSeries_apply_nat (tendsto_pow_of_norm_lt_one p hy) le_rfl,
    (Commute.one_right (y - 1)).add_pow]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [one_pow, mul_one, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_comm]

name: zpPow_add
statement:
theorem zpPow_add {y : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) (a b : ℤ_[p]) :
    zpPow p y (a + b) = zpPow p y a * zpPow p y b
proof:
:= by
  rw [zpPow_def p hy, zpPow_def p hy, zpPow_def p hy]
  exact AddChar.map_add_eq_mul _ a b

name: continuous_zpPow
statement:
private theorem continuous_zpPow {y : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) :
    Continuous (zpPow p y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : zpPow p y =
      (PadicInt.addChar_of_value_at_one (y - 1) (tendsto_pow_of_norm_lt_one p hy) :
        ℤ_[p] → ℂ_[p]) :=
    funext (zpPow_def p hy)
  rw [h]
  exact PadicInt.continuous_addChar_of_value_at_one _

name: zpPow_mem_of_closed
statement:
private theorem zpPow_mem_of_closed {y : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) {S : Set ℂ_[p]}
    (hS : IsClosed S) (hnat : ∀ k : ℕ, y ^ k ∈ S) (a : ℤ_[p]) : zpPow p y a ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Set.range (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ_[p]) ⊆ zpPow p y ⁻¹' S := by
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, zpPow_natCast p hy]
    exact hnat k
  have huniv : zpPow p y ⁻¹' S = Set.univ := by
    rw [← Set.univ_subset_iff, ← PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.closure_range]
    exact (hS.preimage (continuous_zpPow p hy)).closure_subset_iff.mpr hsub
  have : a ∈ zpPow p y ⁻¹' S := by rw [huniv]; trivial
  exact this

name: norm_zpPow_sub_one_lt_one
statement:
theorem norm_zpPow_sub_one_lt_one {y : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) (a : ℤ_[p]) :
    ‖zpPow p y a - 1‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hyle : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [show y = (y - 1) + 1 by ring]
    exact le_trans (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _) (by simp [hy.le])
  
  
  have hball : zpPow p y a ∈ {z : ℂ_[p] | ‖z - 1‖ ≤ ‖y - 1‖} := by
    refine zpPow_mem_of_closed p hy (isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
      (fun k => ?_) a
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [show y ^ (m + 1) - 1 = y * (y ^ m - 1) + (y - 1) by ring]
      refine le_trans (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _) (max_le ?_ le_rfl)
      rw [norm_mul]
      calc ‖y‖ * ‖y ^ m - 1‖ ≤ 1 * ‖y - 1‖ := mul_le_mul hyle ih (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = ‖y - 1‖ := one_mul _
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hball hy

name: zpPow_mul
statement:
theorem zpPow_mul {y : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) (a b : ℤ_[p]) :
    zpPow p y (a * b) = zpPow p (zpPow p y a) b
proof:
:= by
  have hya : ‖zpPow p y a - 1‖ < 1 := norm_zpPow_sub_one_lt_one p hy a
  
  have hnat : ∀ k : ℕ, zpPow p y (a * (k : ℤ_[p])) = zpPow p (zpPow p y a) (k : ℤ_[p]) := by
    intro k
    rw [zpPow_natCast p hya]
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, pow_zero, ← Nat.cast_zero (R := ℤ_[p]),
        zpPow_natCast p hy, pow_zero]
    | succ m ih => rw [Nat.cast_succ, mul_add, mul_one, zpPow_add p hy, ih, pow_succ]
  have hcont1 : Continuous (fun b => zpPow p y (a * b)) :=
    (continuous_zpPow p hy).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
  have heq : (fun b => zpPow p y (a * b)) = (fun b => zpPow p (zpPow p y a) b) :=
    PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.equalizer hcont1 (continuous_zpPow p hya) (funext hnat)
  exact congrFun heq b

name: zpPow_zero
statement: private theorem zpPow_zero {y : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) : zpPow p y 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using zpPow_natCast p hy 0

name: zpPow_one_base
statement: private theorem zpPow_one_base (a : ℤ_[p]) : zpPow p (1 : ℂ_[p]) a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ‖(1 : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1 := by simp
  have hnat : ∀ k : ℕ, zpPow p (1 : ℂ_[p]) (k : ℤ_[p]) = (1 : ℂ_[p]) :=
    fun k => by rw [zpPow_natCast p h1, one_pow]
  have heq : (fun a => zpPow p (1 : ℂ_[p]) a) = (fun _ => (1 : ℂ_[p])) :=
    PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.equalizer (continuous_zpPow p h1) continuous_const (funext hnat)
  exact congrFun heq a

name: zpPow_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem zpPow_ne_zero {y : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) (a : ℤ_[p]) :
    zpPow p y a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : zpPow p y a * zpPow p y (-a) = 1 := by
    rw [← zpPow_add p hy, add_neg_cancel, zpPow_zero p hy]
  rw [h, zero_mul] at h1
  exact one_ne_zero h1.symm

name: norm_mul_sub_one_lt_one
statement:
private theorem norm_mul_sub_one_lt_one {y z : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1)
    (hz : ‖z - 1‖ < 1) : ‖y * z - 1‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hyle : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [show y = (y - 1) + 1 by ring]
    exact le_trans (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _) (by simp [hy.le])
  rw [show y * z - 1 = y * (z - 1) + (y - 1) by ring]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _) (max_lt ?_ hy)
  rw [norm_mul]
  calc ‖y‖ * ‖z - 1‖ ≤ 1 * ‖z - 1‖ := mul_le_mul hyle le_rfl (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
    _ = ‖z - 1‖ := one_mul _
    _ < 1 := hz

name: zpPow_mul_base
statement:
private theorem zpPow_mul_base {y z : ℂ_[p]} (hy : ‖y - 1‖ < 1) (hz : ‖z - 1‖ < 1)
    (a : ℤ_[p]) : zpPow p (y * z) a = zpPow p y a * zpPow p z a
proof:
:= by
  have hyz : ‖y * z - 1‖ < 1 := norm_mul_sub_one_lt_one p hy hz
  have hnat : ∀ k : ℕ,
      zpPow p (y * z) (k : ℤ_[p]) = zpPow p y (k : ℤ_[p]) * zpPow p z (k : ℤ_[p]) :=
    fun k => by rw [zpPow_natCast p hyz, zpPow_natCast p hy, zpPow_natCast p hz, mul_pow]
  have heq : (fun a => zpPow p (y * z) a) = (fun a => zpPow p y a * zpPow p z a) :=
    PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.equalizer (continuous_zpPow p hyz)
      ((continuous_zpPow p hy).mul (continuous_zpPow p hz)) (funext hnat)
  exact congrFun heq a

name: isClosed_K
statement: private theorem isClosed_K (n : ℕ) : IsClosed ((K p n : Set ℂ_[p]))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] (K p n) := Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (R := ℚ_[p])
    (by rw [finrank_K]; exact Nat.totient_pos.2 (pow_pos hp.out.pos n))
  have h := Submodule.closed_of_finiteDimensional ((K p n).toSubalgebra.toSubmodule)
  convert h using 1

name: toCp_mem_K
statement: private theorem toCp_mem_K (n : ℕ) (c : ℤ_[p]) : toCp p c ∈ K p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [toCp, RingHom.comp_apply, PadicInt.Coe.ringHom_apply]
  exact (K p n).algebraMap_mem _

name: zpPow_mem_localUnitsOne
statement:
theorem zpPow_mem_localUnitsOne {n : ℕ} {u : ℂ_[p]ˣ} (hu : u ∈ localUnitsOne p n)
    (a : ℤ_[p]) :
    ∃ v : ℂ_[p]ˣ, (v : ℂ_[p]) = zpPow p (u : ℂ_[p]) a ∧ v ∈ localUnitsOne p n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨huU, hy⟩ := hu
  set y : ℂ_[p] := (u : ℂ_[p]) with hyeq
  have hyK : y ∈ K p n := (Subring.mem_inf.1 huU.1).1
  
  have hmul : zpPow p y a * zpPow p y (-a) = 1 := by
    rw [← zpPow_add p hy, add_neg_cancel, zpPow_zero p hy]
  refine ⟨Units.mkOfMulEqOne (zpPow p y a) (zpPow p y (-a)) hmul, rfl, ?_⟩
  
  have hmemK : ∀ a' : ℤ_[p], zpPow p y a' ∈ K p n :=
    fun a' => zpPow_mem_of_closed p hy (isClosed_K p n) (fun k => pow_mem hyK k) a'
  
  have hnle : ∀ a' : ℤ_[p], ‖zpPow p y a'‖ ≤ 1 := fun a' => by
    rw [show zpPow p y a' = (zpPow p y a' - 1) + 1 by ring]
    exact le_trans (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _)
      (by simp [(norm_zpPow_sub_one_lt_one p hy a').le])
  have hmemO : ∀ a' : ℤ_[p], zpPow p y a' ∈ O p n := fun a' => by
    rw [O, Subring.mem_inf]; exact ⟨hmemK a', hnle a'⟩
  have hinvval : (((Units.mkOfMulEqOne (zpPow p y a) (zpPow p y (-a)) hmul)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])
      = zpPow p y (-a) := by
    rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne]
    exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hmul)).symm
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne]; exact hmemO a
  · rw [hinvval]; exact hmemO (-a)
  · rw [Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne]; exact norm_zpPow_sub_one_lt_one p hy a

name: norm_localUnitsOne_sub_one_lt_one
statement:
private theorem norm_localUnitsOne_sub_one_lt_one {n : ℕ} (g : localUnitsOne p n) :
    ‖((g : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1
proof:
:=
  ((mem_localUnitsOne_iff p).1 g.2).2

name: coe_zpPowUnit
proof:
:=
  (zpPow_mem_localUnitsOne p g.2 a).choose_spec.1

name: localUnitsOne_ext
statement:
private theorem localUnitsOne_ext {n : ℕ} {g h : localUnitsOne p n}
    (hgh : ((g : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = ((h : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])) : g = h
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Units.ext hgh)

name: additive_localUnitsOne_ext
proof:
:=
  Additive.ext_iff.mpr (localUnitsOne_ext p huv)

name: coe_localUnitsOne_smul
statement:
private theorem coe_localUnitsOne_smul {n : ℕ} (a : ℤ_[p])
    (u : Additive (localUnitsOne p n)) :
    (((Additive.toMul (a • u) : localUnitsOne p n) : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])
      = zpPow p (((Additive.toMul u : localUnitsOne p n) : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) a
proof:
:=
  coe_zpPowUnit p a (Additive.toMul u)

name: coe_additive_add
statement:
private theorem coe_additive_add {n : ℕ} (u v : Additive (localUnitsOne p n)) :
    (((Additive.toMul (u + v) : localUnitsOne p n) : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])
      = (((Additive.toMul u : localUnitsOne p n) : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])
        * (((Additive.toMul v : localUnitsOne p n) : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])
proof: := rfl

name: coe_additive_zero
proof: := rfl

name: levelNorm_inv'
statement:
private theorem levelNorm_inv' (n : ℕ) {x : ℂ_[p]} (hx : x ∈ K p (n + 1)) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    levelNorm p n x⁻¹ = (levelNorm p n x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hxinv : x⁻¹ ∈ K p (n + 1) := (K p (n + 1)).inv_mem hx
  have hprod : levelNorm p n x * levelNorm p n x⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [← levelNorm_mul p n hx hxinv, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx0, levelNorm_one]
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hprod)

name: unitsTower1Plus_le_unitsTower1
statement: lemma unitsTower1Plus_le_unitsTower1 : unitsTower1Plus p ≤ unitsTower1 p
proof:
:=
  fun _ hu n hn => (Subgroup.mem_inf.1 (hu n hn)).1

name: mem_invariants_iff
statement: lemma mem_invariants_iff {σ : M →ₗ[R] M} {x : M} : x ∈ invariants σ ↔ σ x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [invariants, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, sub_eq_zero]

name: mem_antiInvariants_iff
statement:
lemma mem_antiInvariants_iff {σ : M →ₗ[R] M} {x : M} :
    x ∈ antiInvariants σ ↔ σ x = -x
proof:
:= by
  rw [antiInvariants, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg]

name: smul_add_apply_mem_invariants
statement:
theorem smul_add_apply_mem_invariants [Invertible (2 : R)] (σ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (hσ : σ ∘ₗ σ = LinearMap.id) (x : M) :
    (⅟(2 : R)) • (x + σ x) ∈ invariants σ
proof:
:= by
  have hσσ : σ (σ x) = x := LinearMap.ext_iff.1 hσ x
  rw [mem_invariants_iff, map_smul, map_add, hσσ, add_comm]

name: smul_sub_apply_mem_antiInvariants
statement:
theorem smul_sub_apply_mem_antiInvariants [Invertible (2 : R)] (σ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (hσ : σ ∘ₗ σ = LinearMap.id) (x : M) :
    (⅟(2 : R)) • (x - σ x) ∈ antiInvariants σ
proof:
:= by
  have hσσ : σ (σ x) = x := LinearMap.ext_iff.1 hσ x
  rw [mem_antiInvariants_iff, map_smul, map_sub, hσσ, ← smul_neg, neg_sub]

name: isCompl_invariants_antiInvariants
statement:
theorem isCompl_invariants_antiInvariants [Invertible (2 : R)] (σ : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (hσ : σ ∘ₗ σ = LinearMap.id) :
    IsCompl (invariants σ) (antiInvariants σ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro x hx hx'
    rw [mem_invariants_iff] at hx
    rw [mem_antiInvariants_iff] at hx'
    have hxx : x = -x := hx.symm.trans hx'
    have h2 : (2 : R) • x = 0 := by rw [two_smul]; exact add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.2 hxx
    have := invOf_smul_smul (2 : R) x
    rwa [h2, smul_zero, eq_comm] at this
  · 
    rw [codisjoint_iff_le_sup]
    intro x _
    rw [Submodule.mem_sup]
    refine ⟨(⅟(2 : R)) • (x + σ x), smul_add_apply_mem_invariants σ hσ x,
      (⅟(2 : R)) • (x - σ x), smul_sub_apply_mem_antiInvariants σ hσ x, ?_⟩
    rw [← smul_add, show x + σ x + (x - σ x) = (2 : R) • x by rw [two_smul]; abel,
      invOf_smul_smul]

name: cAct_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cAct_apply (μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    cAct p μ = dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) * μ
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mulLeft_apply ℤ_[p] _ _

name: cAct_involutive
statement: theorem cAct_involutive : cAct p ∘ₗ cAct p = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun μ => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, cAct_apply, cAct_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, ← mul_assoc,
    units_dirac_mul_dirac, show (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) * (-1) = 1 by rw [neg_mul_neg, one_mul],
    ← units_one_def, one_mul]

name: mem_plusPart_iff
statement:
lemma mem_plusPart_iff {μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ} :
    μ ∈ plusPart p ↔ dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) * μ = μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [plusPart, mem_invariants_iff, cAct_apply]

name: mem_minusPart_iff
statement:
lemma mem_minusPart_iff {μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ} :
    μ ∈ minusPart p ↔ dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) * μ = -μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [minusPart, mem_antiInvariants_iff, cAct_apply]

name: mul_mem_plusPart
statement:
theorem mul_mem_plusPart {μ ν : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ} (hμ : μ ∈ plusPart p) :
    ν * μ ∈ plusPart p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_plusPart_iff] at hμ ⊢
  rw [mul_left_comm, hμ]

name: isCompl_plusPart_minusPart
statement:
theorem isCompl_plusPart_minusPart (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    IsCompl (plusPart p) (minusPart p)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Invertible (2 : ℤ_[p]) := (PadicLFunctions.isUnit_two_padicInt p hp2).invertible
  exact isCompl_invariants_antiInvariants (cAct p) (cAct_involutive p)

name: cAct_apply_unitsPowCM
statement:
theorem cAct_apply_unitsPowCM (μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (k : ℕ) :
    (dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) * μ) (unitsPowCM p k) = (-1) ^ k * μ (unitsPowCM p k)
proof:
:= by
  have hdirac : (dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ)) (unitsPowCM p k) = (-1) ^ k := by
    rw [dirac_apply]
    change ((-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) : ℤ_[p]) ^ k = (-1) ^ k
    rw [Units.val_neg, Units.val_one]
  rw [units_mul_apply_unitsPowCM, hdirac]

name: mem_plusPart_iff_forall_odd_moment
statement:
theorem mem_plusPart_iff_forall_odd_moment {μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ} :
    μ ∈ plusPart p ↔ ∀ k : ℕ, Odd k → μ (unitsPowCM p k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_plusPart_iff]
  constructor
  · 
    intro h k hk
    have heval := LinearMap.congr_fun h (unitsPowCM p k)
    rw [cAct_apply_unitsPowCM, hk.neg_one_pow, neg_one_mul] at heval
    exact add_self_eq_zero.1 (add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.2 heval.symm)
  · 
    intro h
    have hzero : (dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) * μ - μ) = 0 := by
      refine eq_zero_of_forall_unitsPowCM_eq_zero p _ fun k _ => ?_
      rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, cAct_apply_unitsPowCM]
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd k with hk | hk
      · rw [hk.neg_one_pow, one_mul, sub_self]
      · rw [h k hk, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 hzero

name: projPlus_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma projPlus_apply (μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (f : C(GPlus p, ℤ_[p])) :
    projPlus p μ f = μ (f.comp (quotientMk p))
proof: := rfl

name: projPlus_dirac
statement:
@[simp]
lemma projPlus_dirac (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    projPlus p (dirac p u) = dirac p (QuotientGroup.mk u : GPlus p)
proof: := rfl

name: deg_projPlus
statement:
theorem deg_projPlus (μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    deg p (projPlus p μ) = deg p μ
proof:
:= by
  change (projPlus p μ) 1 = μ 1
  rw [projPlus_apply]; congr 1

name: dirac_neg_one_mul_apply
statement:
private lemma dirac_neg_one_mul_apply (μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) (f : C(ℤ_[p]ˣ, ℤ_[p])) :
    (dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) * μ) f = μ (f.comp (negTranslate p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [conv_mul_apply, dirac_apply, innerInt_apply]
  congr 1
  exact ContinuousMap.ext fun u => by
    change f ((-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) * u) = f (-u)
    rw [neg_one_mul]

name: descendEven_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma descendEven_mk (g : C(ℤ_[p]ˣ, ℤ_[p])) (hg : ∀ u : ℤ_[p]ˣ, g (-u) = g u)
    (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    descendEven p g hg (QuotientGroup.mk u) = g u
proof: := rfl

name: descendEven_congr
proof: := by subst h; rfl

name: evenPart_even
statement:
lemma evenPart_even (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (f : C(ℤ_[p]ˣ, ℤ_[p])) (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    evenPart p hp2 f (-u) = evenPart p hp2 f u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evenPart, ContinuousMap.smul_apply, ContinuousMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousMap.comp_apply]
  change _ • (f (-u) + f (-(-u))) = _ • (f u + f (-u))
  rw [neg_neg, add_comm]

name: evenPart_of_even
statement:
private lemma evenPart_of_even (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (f : C(ℤ_[p]ˣ, ℤ_[p]))
    (hf : ∀ u : ℤ_[p]ˣ, f (-u) = f u) : evenPart p hp2 f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  simp only [evenPart, ContinuousMap.smul_apply, ContinuousMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change _ * (f u + f (-u)) = f u
  rw [hf u, ← two_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    (PadicLFunctions.isUnit_two_padicInt p hp2).val_inv_mul, one_mul]

name: evenPart_comp_negTranslate
statement:
private lemma evenPart_comp_negTranslate (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (f : C(ℤ_[p]ˣ, ℤ_[p])) :
    evenPart p hp2 (f.comp (negTranslate p)) = evenPart p hp2 f
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  simp only [evenPart, ContinuousMap.smul_apply, ContinuousMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousMap.comp_apply]
  change _ • (f (-u) + f (-(-u))) = _ • (f u + f (-u))
  rw [neg_neg, add_comm]

name: plusSection_mem_plusPart
statement:
theorem plusSection_mem_plusPart (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (ν : PadicMeasure p (GPlus p)) :
    plusSection p hp2 ν ∈ plusPart p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_plusPart_iff]
  refine LinearMap.ext fun f => ?_
  
  rw [dirac_neg_one_mul_apply]
  change ν (descendEven p (evenPart p hp2 (f.comp (negTranslate p))) _)
    = ν (descendEven p (evenPart p hp2 f) _)
  congr 1
  exact descendEven_congr p (evenPart_comp_negTranslate p hp2 f) _ _

name: quotientMk_neg
statement:
private lemma quotientMk_neg (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    (QuotientGroup.mk (-u) : GPlus p) = QuotientGroup.mk u
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuotientGroup.eq, Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff]
  exact ⟨1, by rw [zpow_one, inv_neg, neg_mul, inv_mul_cancel]⟩

name: comp_quotientMk_even
statement:
private lemma comp_quotientMk_even (g : C(GPlus p, ℤ_[p])) (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    (g.comp (quotientMk p)) (-u) = (g.comp (quotientMk p)) u
proof:
:= by
  change g (QuotientGroup.mk (-u)) = g (QuotientGroup.mk u)
  rw [quotientMk_neg]

name: descendEven_comp_quotientMk
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  induction x using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
  | _ u => rw [descendEven_mk]; rfl

name: projPlus_plusSection
statement:
theorem projPlus_plusSection (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (ν : PadicMeasure p (GPlus p)) :
    projPlus p (plusSection p hp2 ν) = ν
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun g => ?_
  rw [projPlus_apply]
  change ν (descendEven p (evenPart p hp2 (g.comp (quotientMk p))) _) = ν g
  congr 1
  
  rw [descendEven_congr p (evenPart_of_even p hp2 _ (comp_quotientMk_even p g)) _
    (comp_quotientMk_even p g)]
  exact descendEven_comp_quotientMk p g (comp_quotientMk_even p g)

name: descendEven_comp
statement:
private lemma descendEven_comp (g : C(ℤ_[p]ˣ, ℤ_[p])) (hg : ∀ u : ℤ_[p]ˣ, g (-u) = g u) :
    (descendEven p g hg).comp (quotientMk p) = g
proof:
:= by
  ext u; change descendEven p g hg (QuotientGroup.mk u) = g u; rw [descendEven_mk]

name: apply_evenPart_of_mem_plusPart
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcomp : μ (f.comp (negTranslate p)) = μ f := by
    rw [← dirac_neg_one_mul_apply, (mem_plusPart_iff p).1 hμ]
  rw [evenPart, map_smul, map_add, hcomp, smul_eq_mul, ← two_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    (PadicLFunctions.isUnit_two_padicInt p hp2).val_inv_mul, one_mul]

name: plusSection_projPlus
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun f => ?_
  change (projPlus p μ) (descendEven p (evenPart p hp2 f) (evenPart_even p hp2 f)) = μ f
  rw [projPlus_apply, descendEven_comp, apply_evenPart_of_mem_plusPart p hp2 hμ]

name: projPlus_surjective
statement:
theorem projPlus_surjective (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    Function.Surjective (projPlus p)
proof:
:=
  fun ν => ⟨plusSection p hp2 ν, projPlus_plusSection p hp2 ν⟩

name: projPlus_eq_zero_of_mem_minusPart
statement:
private lemma projPlus_eq_zero_of_mem_minusPart {ρ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ}
    (hρ : ρ ∈ minusPart p) : projPlus p ρ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun g => ?_
  rw [projPlus_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  
  have heven : (g.comp (quotientMk p)).comp (negTranslate p) = g.comp (quotientMk p) :=
    ContinuousMap.ext fun u => by
      change (g.comp (quotientMk p)) (-u) = (g.comp (quotientMk p)) u
      exact comp_quotientMk_even p g u
  
  have hneg : ρ (g.comp (quotientMk p)) = -ρ (g.comp (quotientMk p)) := by
    have h := dirac_neg_one_mul_apply p ρ (g.comp (quotientMk p))
    rw [heven, (mem_minusPart_iff p).1 hρ, LinearMap.neg_apply] at h
    exact h.symm
  exact add_self_eq_zero.1 (add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.2 hneg)

name: projPlus_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem projPlus_eq_zero_iff (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ} :
    projPlus p μ = 0 ↔ μ ∈ minusPart p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, -⟩ :=
      Submodule.existsUnique_add_of_isCompl (isCompl_plusPart_minusPart p hp2) μ
    have hpa : projPlus p (a : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) = 0 := by
      have : projPlus p μ = projPlus p (a : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) := by
        rw [← hab, map_add, projPlus_eq_zero_of_mem_minusPart p b.2, add_zero]
      rw [← this, h]
    have haz : (a : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) = 0 := by
      have := plusSection_projPlus p hp2 a.2
      rw [hpa, map_zero] at this
      exact this.symm
    rw [← hab, haz, zero_add]
    exact b.2
  · intro h
    exact projPlus_eq_zero_of_mem_minusPart p h

name: ker_projPlus
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, projPlus_eq_zero_iff p hp2, mem_minusPart_iff,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · 
    intro hx
    refine ⟨(-(((PadicLFunctions.isUnit_two_padicInt p hp2).unit⁻¹ : ℤ_[p]ˣ) : ℤ_[p])) • x, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_smul_comm, sub_mul, hx, one_mul,
      show (-x - x : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) = -((2 : ℤ_[p]) • x) from by rw [two_smul]; abel,
      smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg, smul_smul,
      (PadicLFunctions.isUnit_two_padicInt p hp2).val_inv_mul, one_smul]
  · 
    rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_sub, units_dirac_mul_dirac, neg_mul_neg, one_mul, mul_one,
      ← units_one_def,
      show (1 : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]ˣ) - dirac p (-1 : ℤ_[p]ˣ) = -(dirac p (-1) - 1) from by abel]
    exact neg_mul _ _

name: prod_sub_one_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a t ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
    have hih := ih (fun i hi => hle i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
      (fun i hi => hone i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
    rw [show f a * (∏ i ∈ t, f i) - 1 = f a * ((∏ i ∈ t, f i) - 1) + (f a - 1) by ring]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _) (max_lt ?_ ?_)
    · rw [norm_mul]
      calc ‖f a‖ * ‖(∏ i ∈ t, f i) - 1‖ ≤ 1 * ‖(∏ i ∈ t, f i) - 1‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hle a (Finset.mem_insert_self a t)) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖(∏ i ∈ t, f i) - 1‖ := one_mul _
        _ < 1 := hih
    · exact hone a (Finset.mem_insert_self a t)

name: norm_coe_eq_spectralNorm_ES
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) :=
    finiteDimensional_K p (n + 1)
  refine spectralNorm_unique_field_norm_ext (K := ℚ_[p])
    (L := IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) (f := restrictAbsES p) (fun k => ?_) z
  change ‖((algebraMap ℚ_[p] (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) k) : ℂ_[p])‖ = ‖k‖
  rw [show ((algebraMap ℚ_[p] (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) k) : ℂ_[p])
      = algebraMap ℚ_[p] ℂ_[p] k from by rw [← IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply]; rfl]
  simp

name: norm_algEquiv_ES
statement:
private theorem norm_algEquiv_ES {n : ℕ}
    (σ : (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) ≃ₐ[ℚ_[p]]
         (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)))
    (z : IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) :
    ‖(σ z : ℂ_[p])‖ = ‖(z : ℂ_[p])‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_coe_eq_spectralNorm_ES p (σ z), norm_coe_eq_spectralNorm_ES p z,
    spectralNorm, spectralNorm, minpoly.algEquiv_eq σ z]

name: norm_levelNorm_sub_one_lt_one
statement:
theorem norm_levelNorm_sub_one_lt_one {n : ℕ} {w : ℂ_[p]} (hw : w ∈ K p (n + 1))
    (hwone : ‖w - 1‖ < 1) :
    ‖levelNorm p n w - 1‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) :=
    finiteDimensional_K p (n + 1)
  haveI : FiniteDimensional (K p n) (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) :=
    FiniteDimensional.right ℚ_[p] (K p n) _
  haveI hgalQ : IsGalois ℚ_[p] (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) := by
    have heq : (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)).restrictScalars ℚ_[p]
        = K p (n + 1) := rfl
    have h2 : IsGalois ℚ_[p]
        ((IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)).restrictScalars ℚ_[p]) := by
      rw [heq]; exact isGalois_K p (n + 1)
    exact h2
  haveI : IsGalois (K p n) (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) :=
    IsGalois.tower_top_of_isGalois ℚ_[p] (K p n) _
  set W : IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n) :=
    ⟨w, (IntermediateField.mem_extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)).2 hw⟩ with hW
  have hwnorm : ‖w‖ = 1 := by
    have hle : ‖w‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have h := IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max (w - 1) (1 : ℂ_[p])
      rw [sub_add_cancel, norm_one] at h
      exact le_trans h (max_le hwone.le le_rfl)
    have hge : 1 ≤ ‖w‖ := by
      have h := IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max w (1 - w)
      rw [add_sub_cancel, norm_one] at h
      have h1w : ‖(1 : ℂ_[p]) - w‖ < 1 := by rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact hwone
      rcases le_max_iff.mp h with hh | hh
      · exact hh
      · linarith
    linarith
  have hprod := Algebra.norm_eq_prod_automorphisms (K p n) W
  have hcoe : (levelNorm p n w) = ∏ σ : (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n))
        ≃ₐ[K p n] (IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)), (σ W : ℂ_[p]) := by
    rw [levelNorm_apply p n hw]
    have hc := congrArg
      (fun (z : IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) => (z : ℂ_[p])) hprod
    rw [IntermediateField.coe_prod] at hc
    rw [← hc]; rfl
  rw [hcoe]
  refine prod_sub_one_lt_one p _ _ (fun σ _ => ?_) (fun σ _ => ?_)
  · rw [show (σ W : ℂ_[p]) = ((σ.restrictScalars ℚ_[p]) W : ℂ_[p]) from rfl,
      norm_algEquiv_ES p (σ.restrictScalars ℚ_[p]) W]
    rw [show (W : ℂ_[p]) = w from rfl, hwnorm]
  · have hσ1 : (σ W : ℂ_[p]) - 1 = (σ (W - 1) : ℂ_[p]) := by rw [map_sub, map_one]; rfl
    rw [hσ1, show (σ (W - 1) : ℂ_[p]) = ((σ.restrictScalars ℚ_[p]) (W - 1) : ℂ_[p]) from rfl,
      norm_algEquiv_ES p (σ.restrictScalars ℚ_[p]) (W - 1)]
    rw [show ((W - 1 : IntermediateField.extendScalars (K_le_succ p n)) : ℂ_[p]) = w - 1 from by
      push_cast; rfl]
    exact hwone

name: residueZp_spec
statement:
private theorem residueZp_spec (u : NormCompatUnits p) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ‖(u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) - toCp p (residueZp p u n hn)‖ ≤ ‖pi p n‖
proof:
:=
  (exists_residue_pi p hn (Subring.mem_inf.1 (u.mem n)).1
    (Subring.mem_inf.1 (u.mem n)).2).choose_spec

name: toZMod_residueZp_succ
proof:
:= by
  set c : ℂ_[p] := (u.elems (n + 1) : ℂ_[p]) with hc
  set a₁ : ℤ_[p] := residueZp p u (n + 1) hn1 with ha1
  set a₀ : ℤ_[p] := residueZp p u n hn with ha0
  have hcK : c ∈ K p (n + 1) := (Subring.mem_inf.1 (u.mem (n + 1))).1
  have hcnorm : ‖c‖ = 1 := norm_eq_one_of_mem_localUnits p
    ((mem_localUnits_iff p).2
      ⟨u.mem (n + 1), by rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]; exact u.inv_mem (n + 1)⟩)
  have hsmall1 : ‖c - toCp p a₁‖ < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (residueZp_spec p u (n + 1) hn1) (norm_pi_lt_one p (by omega))
  have ha1norm : ‖a₁‖ = 1 := by
    rw [← norm_toCp p a₁]
    have hh := IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max (toCp p a₁) (c - toCp p a₁)
    rw [show toCp p a₁ + (c - toCp p a₁) = c by ring] at hh
    have hle : ‖toCp p a₁‖ ≤ 1 := by rw [norm_toCp]; exact PadicInt.norm_le_one _
    rcases le_max_iff.mp hh with h1 | h1
    · linarith [hcnorm.ge]
    · linarith [hsmall1]
  have ha1ne : toCp p a₁ ≠ 0 := by rw [← norm_pos_iff, norm_toCp, ha1norm]; exact one_pos
  set w : ℂ_[p] := c * (toCp p a₁)⁻¹ with hw
  have hwK : w ∈ K p (n + 1) := mul_mem hcK ((K p (n + 1)).inv_mem (by
    rw [toCp, RingHom.comp_apply, PadicInt.Coe.ringHom_apply]
    exact (K p (n + 1)).algebraMap_mem _))
  have hwone : ‖w - 1‖ < 1 := by
    rw [show w - 1 = (c - toCp p a₁) * (toCp p a₁)⁻¹ by rw [hw, sub_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha1ne],
      norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_toCp, ha1norm, inv_one, mul_one]
    exact hsmall1
  have hcfac : c = toCp p a₁ * w := by
    rw [hw, mul_comm (toCp p a₁), mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha1ne, mul_one]
  have htoa1K : toCp p a₁ ∈ K p (n + 1) := by
    rw [toCp, RingHom.comp_apply, PadicInt.Coe.ringHom_apply]; exact (K p (n + 1)).algebraMap_mem _
  have htoa1Kn : toCp p a₁ ∈ K p n := by
    rw [toCp, RingHom.comp_apply, PadicInt.Coe.ringHom_apply]; exact (K p n).algebraMap_mem _
  have hNc : levelNorm p n c = (toCp p a₁) ^ p * levelNorm p n w := by
    rw [hcfac, levelNorm_mul p n htoa1K hwK, levelNorm_const_eq_pow p hn htoa1Kn]
  have hun : (u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) = levelNorm p n c := (u.compat n hn).symm
  have hun_a0 : ‖(u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) - toCp p a₀‖ < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (residueZp_spec p u n hn) (norm_pi_lt_one p hn)
  have hNw : ‖levelNorm p n w - 1‖ < 1 := norm_levelNorm_sub_one_lt_one p hwK hwone
  have hkey2 : ‖toCp p a₀ - (toCp p a₁) ^ p‖ < 1 := by
    rw [show toCp p a₀ - (toCp p a₁) ^ p
        = (toCp p a₀ - (u.elems n : ℂ_[p])) + ((toCp p a₁) ^ p * (levelNorm p n w - 1)) by
      rw [hun, hNc]; ring]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _) (max_lt ?_ ?_)
    · rw [show toCp p a₀ - (u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) = -((u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) - toCp p a₀) by ring,
        norm_neg]
      exact hun_a0
    · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_toCp, ha1norm, one_pow, one_mul]
      exact hNw
  have hkey3 : ‖a₀ - a₁ ^ p‖ < 1 := by
    rw [← norm_toCp p (a₀ - a₁ ^ p), map_sub, map_pow]; exact hkey2
  have hmem : a₀ - a₁ ^ p ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[p] := by
    rw [PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← PadicInt.norm_lt_one_iff_dvd]
    exact hkey3
  have hz : PadicInt.toZMod a₀ = PadicInt.toZMod (a₁ ^ p) := by
    have h0 : PadicInt.toZMod (a₀ - a₁ ^ p) = 0 := by
      rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, PadicInt.ker_toZMod]; exact hmem
    rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h0; exact h0
  rw [hz, map_pow, ZMod.pow_card]

name: toZMod_residueZp_eq_one
statement:
private theorem toZMod_residueZp_eq_one (u : NormCompatUnits p) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    PadicInt.toZMod (residueZp p u n hn) = PadicInt.toZMod (residueZp p u 1 (le_refl 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 (m + 1) with h1 | h1
    · have hm : 1 ≤ m := by omega
      rw [toZMod_residueZp_succ p u hm hn, ih hm]
    · have hm0 : m = 0 := by omega
      subst hm0; congr 1

name: omegaNCU_torsion
statement: theorem omegaNCU_torsion (b : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (n : ℕ) : (omegaNCU p b).elems n ^ (p - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_one]
  change (toCp p ((PadicInt.isUnit_teichmullerFun p b).unit : ℤ_[p])) ^ (p - 1) = 1
  rw [IsUnit.unit_spec, ← map_pow, PadicInt.teichmullerFun_pow_card_sub_one p b, map_one]

name: omegaNCU_elems
statement:
theorem omegaNCU_elems (b : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((omegaNCU p b).elems n : ℂ_[p]) = toCp p (PadicInt.teichmullerFun p (b : ℤ_[p]))
proof:
:= by
  change (toCp p ((PadicInt.isUnit_teichmullerFun p b).unit : ℤ_[p])) = _
  rw [IsUnit.unit_spec]

name: norm_residueZp
statement:
private theorem norm_residueZp (u : NormCompatUnits p) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ‖residueZp p u n hn‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  set c : ℂ_[p] := (u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) with hc
  have hcnorm : ‖c‖ = 1 := norm_eq_one_of_mem_localUnits p
    ((mem_localUnits_iff p).2 ⟨u.mem n, by rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]; exact u.inv_mem n⟩)
  have hsmall : ‖c - toCp p (residueZp p u n hn)‖ < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (residueZp_spec p u n hn) (norm_pi_lt_one p hn)
  rw [← norm_toCp p (residueZp p u n hn)]
  have hh := IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max (toCp p (residueZp p u n hn))
    (c - toCp p (residueZp p u n hn))
  rw [show toCp p (residueZp p u n hn) + (c - toCp p (residueZp p u n hn)) = c by ring] at hh
  have hle : ‖toCp p (residueZp p u n hn)‖ ≤ 1 := by rw [norm_toCp]; exact PadicInt.norm_le_one _
  rcases le_max_iff.mp hh with h1 | h1
  · linarith [hcnorm.ge]
  · linarith [hsmall]

name: teichUnit_val
statement:
private theorem teichUnit_val (u : NormCompatUnits p) :
    (teichUnit p u : ℤ_[p]) = residueZp p u 1 (le_refl 1)
proof: := IsUnit.unit_spec _

name: norm_elems_sub_omega_lt_one
statement:
private theorem norm_elems_sub_omega_lt_one (u : NormCompatUnits p) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ‖(u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) - toCp p (PadicInt.teichmullerFun p (teichUnit p u : ℤ_[p]))‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  set a₀ : ℤ_[p] := residueZp p u n hn with ha0
  set b : ℤ_[p] := (teichUnit p u : ℤ_[p]) with hb
  have h1 : ‖(u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) - toCp p a₀‖ < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (residueZp_spec p u n hn) (norm_pi_lt_one p hn)
  have hres : PadicInt.toZMod a₀ = PadicInt.toZMod b := by
    rw [hb, teichUnit_val]; exact toZMod_residueZp_eq_one p u hn
  have homega : PadicInt.teichmullerFun p a₀ = PadicInt.teichmullerFun p b := by
    rw [PadicInt.teichmullerFun, PadicInt.teichmullerFun, hres]
  have h2 : ‖toCp p a₀ - toCp p (PadicInt.teichmullerFun p b)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [← homega, ← map_sub, norm_toCp]
    have hmem : a₀ - PadicInt.teichmullerFun p a₀ ∈ Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p])} := by
      rw [show a₀ - PadicInt.teichmullerFun p a₀
          = -(PadicInt.teichmullerFun p a₀ - a₀) by ring, neg_mem_iff]
      exact PadicInt.teichmullerFun_sub_self_mem p a₀
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← PadicInt.norm_lt_one_iff_dvd] at hmem
    exact hmem
  rw [show (u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) - toCp p (PadicInt.teichmullerFun p b)
      = ((u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) - toCp p a₀)
        + (toCp p a₀ - toCp p (PadicInt.teichmullerFun p b)) by ring]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _) (max_lt h1 h2)

name: normCompat_eq_teichmuller_mul_principal
statement:
theorem normCompat_eq_teichmuller_mul_principal (u : NormCompatUnits p) :
    ∃ v w : NormCompatUnits p, w ∈ unitsTower1 p ∧
      (∀ n, (v.elems n) ^ (p - 1) = 1) ∧ u = v * w
proof:
:= by
  set b : ℤ_[p]ˣ := teichUnit p u with hb
  set v : NormCompatUnits p := omegaNCU p b with hv
  set w : NormCompatUnits p := v⁻¹ * u with hw
  refine ⟨v, w, ?_, fun n => omegaNCU_torsion p b n, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    have hwval : ((w.elems n : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])
        = (toCp p (PadicInt.teichmullerFun p (b : ℤ_[p])))⁻¹ * (u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) := by
      change ((v⁻¹.elems n * u.elems n : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = _
      rw [Units.val_mul, show v⁻¹.elems n = (v.elems n)⁻¹ from rfl, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val,
        omegaNCU_elems p b n]
    set ζ := toCp p (PadicInt.teichmullerFun p (b : ℤ_[p])) with hζ
    have hζnorm : ‖ζ‖ = 1 := by
      rw [hζ, norm_toCp]; exact PadicInt.isUnit_iff.1 (PadicInt.isUnit_teichmullerFun p b)
    have hζne : ζ ≠ 0 := by rw [← norm_pos_iff, hζnorm]; exact one_pos
    refine (mem_localUnitsOne_iff (p := p)).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (mem_localUnits_iff p).2
        ⟨w.mem n, by rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]; exact w.inv_mem n⟩
    · rw [hwval,
        show ζ⁻¹ * (u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) - 1 = ζ⁻¹ * ((u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) - ζ) by
          rw [mul_sub, inv_mul_cancel₀ hζne],
        norm_mul, norm_inv, hζnorm, inv_one, one_mul]
      exact norm_elems_sub_omega_lt_one p u hn
  · rw [hw, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]

name: zetaNeg_eq_riemannZeta
statement:
theorem zetaNeg_eq_riemannZeta (k : ℕ) :
    ((zetaNeg k : ℚ) : ℂ) = riemannZeta (-(k : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannZeta_neg_nat_eq_bernoulli, zetaNeg]
  push_cast
  ring

name: zetaNeg_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zetaNeg_zero : zetaNeg 0 = -(1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [zetaNeg, bernoulli_one]

name: zetaNeg_eq_zero_of_even
statement: lemma zetaNeg_eq_zero_of_even {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (h : Even k) : zetaNeg k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [zetaNeg, bernoulli_eq_zero_of_odd h.add_one (by omega), mul_zero, zero_div]

name: neg_one_pow_mul_one_sub_pow_mul_zetaNeg
statement:
lemma neg_one_pow_mul_one_sub_pow_mul_zetaNeg (q : ℚ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    (-1) ^ k * ((1 - q ^ (k - 1)) * zetaNeg (k - 1))
      = (1 - q ^ (k - 1)) * zetaNeg (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hk1 := eq_or_ne k 1
  · simp
  · rcases Nat.even_or_odd k with he | ho
    · rw [he.neg_one_pow, one_mul]
    · rw [zetaNeg_eq_zero_of_even (by omega) (Nat.Odd.sub_odd ho odd_one)]
      ring

name: isUnit_natCast_of_not_dvd
statement:
lemma isUnit_natCast_of_not_dvd {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] {a : ℕ} (hpa : ¬ p ∣ a) :
    IsUnit (a : ℤ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  rw [PadicInt.isUnit_iff]
  refine le_antisymm (PadicInt.norm_le_one _) (not_lt.1 fun h => hpa ?_)
  exact_mod_cast (PadicInt.norm_int_lt_one_iff_dvd (a : ℤ)).1 (by simpa using h)

name: constantCoeff_geomSum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma constantCoeff_geomSum (a : ℕ) : constantCoeff (geomSum p a) = (a : ℤ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  simp [geomSum]

name: geomSum_mul_X
statement: lemma geomSum_mul_X (a : ℕ) : geomSum p a * X = (1 + X) ^ a - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := geom_sum_mul (1 + X : PowerSeries ℤ_[p]) a
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at h
  exact h

name: isUnit_geomSum
statement: lemma isUnit_geomSum {a : ℕ} (hpa : ¬ p ∣ a) : IsUnit (geomSum p a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, constantCoeff_geomSum]
  exact PadicInt.isUnit_natCast_of_not_dvd hpa

name: X_mul_FaNum
statement:
lemma X_mul_FaNum (a : ℕ) :
    X * FaNum p a = geomSum p a - (a : PowerSeries ℤ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
    rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, map_sub, ← map_natCast (PowerSeries.C (R := ℤ_[p])) a,
      PowerSeries.coeff_C]
    simp [FaNum]

name: geomSum_mul_Fa
statement:
lemma geomSum_mul_Fa {a : ℕ} (hpa : ¬ p ∣ a) :
    geomSum p a * Fa p a = FaNum p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fa, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (geomSum p a) (FaNum p a), mul_assoc,
    Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ (isUnit_geomSum p hpa), mul_one]

name: one_add_X_pow_sub_one_mul_Fa
statement:
lemma one_add_X_pow_sub_one_mul_Fa {a : ℕ} (hpa : ¬ p ∣ a) :
    ((1 + X) ^ a - 1) * Fa p a = geomSum p a - (a : PowerSeries ℤ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  rw [← geomSum_mul_X, mul_comm (geomSum p a) X, mul_assoc, geomSum_mul_Fa p hpa,
    X_mul_FaNum]

name: mahlerTransform_muA
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mahlerTransform_muA (a : ℕ) : mahlerTransform p (muA p a) = Fa p a
proof:
:=
  (mahlerLinearEquiv p).apply_symm_apply (Fa p a)

name: mahlerTransform_sub
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mahlerTransform_sub (μ ν : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]) :
    mahlerTransform p (μ - ν) = mahlerTransform p μ - mahlerTransform p ν
proof:
:=
  map_sub (mahlerTransformₗ p) μ ν

name: mahlerTransform_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mahlerTransform_smul (c : ℤ_[p]) (μ : PadicMeasure p ℤ_[p]) :
    mahlerTransform p (c • μ) = c • mahlerTransform p μ
proof:
:=
  map_smul (mahlerTransformₗ p) c μ

name: dirac_natCast_sub_one_mul_muA
statement:
