name: mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet
statement:
private theorem mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet {n : ℕ} {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ}
    (hv : v ∈ Subgroup.closure (cycloGenSet p n)) : (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n
proof:
:= by
  induction hv using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      rcases hz with hξ | hξ | ⟨b, _, _, hbv⟩
      · rw [hξ]; exact zetaSys_mem_K p n
      · rw [hξ]; exact neg_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n)
      · rw [hbv]; exact sub_mem (pow_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n) b) (one_mem _)
  | one => rw [Units.val_one]; exact one_mem _
  | mul z₁ z₂ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => rw [Units.val_mul]; exact mul_mem ih₁ ih₂
  | inv z _ ih => rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]; exact (K p n).inv_mem ih

name: galAutVal_mem
statement:
private theorem galAutVal_mem (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} {x : ℂ_[p]} (h : x ∈ K p n) :
    galAutVal p a n x = (galAut p a n ⟨x, h⟩ : ℂ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  rw [galAutVal, dif_pos h]

name: galAutVal_mul
statement:
private theorem galAutVal_mul (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} {x y : ℂ_[p]} (hx : x ∈ K p n)
    (hy : y ∈ K p n) : galAutVal p a n (x * y) = galAutVal p a n x * galAutVal p a n y
proof:
:= by
  rw [galAutVal_mem p a (mul_mem hx hy), galAutVal_mem p a hx, galAutVal_mem p a hy,
    show (⟨x * y, mul_mem hx hy⟩ : K p n) = ⟨x, hx⟩ * ⟨y, hy⟩ from Subtype.ext rfl,
    map_mul, IntermediateField.coe_mul]

name: galAutVal_inv
statement:
private theorem galAutVal_inv (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} {x : ℂ_[p]} (hx : x ∈ K p n) :
    galAutVal p a n x⁻¹ = (galAutVal p a n x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [galAutVal_mem p a ((K p n).inv_mem hx), galAutVal_mem p a hx,
    show (⟨x⁻¹, (K p n).inv_mem hx⟩ : K p n) = (⟨x, hx⟩)⁻¹ from
      Subtype.ext (by rw [IntermediateField.coe_inv]), map_inv₀, IntermediateField.coe_inv]

name: galAutVal_zetaSys_pow
statement:
private theorem galAutVal_zetaSys_pow (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) :
    galAutVal p a n (zetaSys p n ^ k)
      = zetaSys p n ^ (((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) :
          ZMod (p ^ n)).val * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [galAutVal_mem p a (pow_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n) k), galAut_zetaSys_pow p a hn k]

name: galAutVal_neg_one
statement:
private theorem galAutVal_neg_one (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} :
    galAutVal p a n (-1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [galAutVal_mem p a (neg_mem (one_mem _)),
    show (⟨(-1 : ℂ_[p]), neg_mem (one_mem _)⟩ : K p n) = -1 from
      Subtype.ext (by push_cast; ring),
    map_neg, map_one, IntermediateField.coe_neg, IntermediateField.coe_one]

name: galAutVal_add
statement:
private theorem galAutVal_add (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} {x y : ℂ_[p]} (hx : x ∈ K p n)
    (hy : y ∈ K p n) : galAutVal p a n (x + y) = galAutVal p a n x + galAutVal p a n y
proof:
:= by
  rw [galAutVal_mem p a (add_mem hx hy), galAutVal_mem p a hx, galAutVal_mem p a hy,
    show (⟨x + y, add_mem hx hy⟩ : K p n) = ⟨x, hx⟩ + ⟨y, hy⟩ from Subtype.ext rfl,
    map_add, IntermediateField.coe_add]

name: galAutVal_cycloUnit
statement:
private theorem galAutVal_cycloUnit (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (b : ℕ) :
    galAutVal p a n (cycloUnit p b n)
      = (zetaSys p n ^ (((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) :
          ZMod (p ^ n)).val * b) - 1)
        / (zetaSys p n ^ ((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) :
          ZMod (p ^ n)).val - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hξ : zetaSys p n ∈ K p n := zetaSys_mem_K p n
  rw [cycloUnit, div_eq_mul_inv, galAutVal_mul p a (sub_mem (pow_mem hξ b) (one_mem _))
      ((K p n).inv_mem (sub_mem hξ (one_mem _))),
    galAutVal_inv p a (sub_mem hξ (one_mem _)), ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  congr 1
  · rw [show zetaSys p n ^ b - 1 = zetaSys p n ^ b + (-1) from by ring,
      galAutVal_add p a (pow_mem hξ b) (neg_mem (one_mem _)),
      galAutVal_zetaSys_pow p a hn b, galAutVal_neg_one p a]
    ring
  · rw [show zetaSys p n - 1 = zetaSys p n ^ 1 + (-1) from by rw [pow_one]; ring,
      galAutVal_add p a (pow_mem hξ 1) (neg_mem (one_mem _)),
      galAutVal_zetaSys_pow p a hn 1, galAutVal_neg_one p a, mul_one]
    ring

name: prod_range_div_telescope
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rw [Finset.range_zero, Finset.prod_empty, div_self (he 0)]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih, div_mul_div_comm,
      mul_comm (e m) (e (m + 1)), mul_div_mul_right _ _ (he m)]

name: charExp_cast
proof:
:= by
  rw [charExp, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← map_pow]

name: zetaSys_pow_charExp_sub_one_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem zetaSys_pow_charExp_sub_one_ne_zero (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (i : ℕ) :
    zetaSys p n ^ charExp p a n i - 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (1 < p ^ n) := ⟨one_lt_pow₀ hp.out.one_lt (by omega)⟩
  refine sub_ne_zero_of_ne fun h => ?_
  have hord := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h
  rw [← (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).eq_orderOf] at hord
  
  have hz : ((charExp p a n i : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) = 0 := by
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]; exact hord
  rw [charExp, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id] at hz
  exact (PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n (a ^ i)).ne_zero hz

name: prod_galAutVal_cycloUnit_telescope
statement:
private theorem prod_galAutVal_cycloUnit_telescope (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {b : ℕ} (hb : ((b : ZMod (p ^ n))) = (PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ))
    (r : ℕ) :
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range r, galAutVal p (a ^ i) n (cycloUnit p b n)
      = (zetaSys p n ^ (((b : ZMod (p ^ n)) ^ r).val) - 1) / (zetaSys p n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hnum : ∀ i, zetaSys p n ^ (charExp p a n i * b) = zetaSys p n ^ charExp p a n (i + 1) := by
    intro i
    refine zetaSys_pow_eq_pow_of_modEq p ?_
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff, Nat.cast_mul, charExp_cast, charExp_cast, hb, pow_succ]
  have hfac : ∀ i, galAutVal p (a ^ i) n (cycloUnit p b n)
      = (zetaSys p n ^ charExp p a n (i + 1) - 1) / (zetaSys p n ^ charExp p a n i - 1) := by
    intro i
    rw [galAutVal_cycloUnit p (a ^ i) hn b, ← hnum i]
    rfl
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => hfac i]
  
  rw [prod_range_div_telescope (fun i => zetaSys p n ^ charExp p a n i - 1)
    (fun i => zetaSys_pow_charExp_sub_one_ne_zero p a hn i) r]
  
  have hr : zetaSys p n ^ charExp p a n r = zetaSys p n ^ ((b : ZMod (p ^ n)) ^ r).val := by
    refine zetaSys_pow_eq_pow_of_modEq p ?_
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff, charExp_cast, hb, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id]
  have h0 : zetaSys p n ^ charExp p a n 0 = zetaSys p n := by
    have h := charExp_cast p a (n := n) 0
    rw [pow_zero] at h
    refine (zetaSys_pow_eq_pow_of_modEq (i := charExp p a n 0) (j := 1) p ?_).trans (pow_one _)
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff, h, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hr, h0]

name: galAut_mem_closure_cycloGenSet
statement:
private theorem galAut_mem_closure_cycloGenSet (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ} (hv : v ∈ Subgroup.closure (cycloGenSet p n)) :
    ∃ w : ℂ_[p]ˣ, w ∈ Subgroup.closure (cycloGenSet p n) ∧
      (w : ℂ_[p]) = galAutVal p a n (v : ℂ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  
  have ht_dvd : ∀ b : ℕ, 1 ≤ b → b ≤ p ^ n - 1 →
      ¬ p ^ n ∣ ((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) :
        ZMod (p ^ n)).val * b := by
    intro b hb1 hb2 hdvd
    have hpn1 : 1 < p ^ n := one_lt_pow₀ hp.out.one_lt (by omega)
    have htb : (((((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) :
        ZMod (p ^ n)).val * b : ℕ)) : ZMod (p ^ n)) = 0 := by
      rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]; exact hdvd
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id] at htb
    have hbz : ((b : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) = 0 :=
      (Units.mul_right_eq_zero (PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a)).1 htb
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at hbz
    exact absurd (Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hbz (by omega)) (by omega)
  induction hv using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      rcases hz with hξ | hξ | ⟨b, hb1, hb2, hbv⟩
      · 
        obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwval⟩ := zetaSys_pow_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p (n := n)
          ((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) : ZMod (p ^ n)).val
        refine ⟨w, hwmem, ?_⟩
        have := galAutVal_zetaSys_pow p a hn 1
        rw [pow_one, mul_one] at this
        rw [hwval, hξ, this]
      · 
        obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwval⟩ := zetaSys_pow_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p (n := n)
          ((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) : ZMod (p ^ n)).val
        obtain ⟨w', hw'mem, hw'val⟩ : ∃ w' : ℂ_[p]ˣ,
            w' ∈ Subgroup.closure (cycloGenSet p n) ∧ (w' : ℂ_[p]) = -1 :=
          ⟨-1, neg_one_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hn _ rfl, by rw [Units.val_neg, Units.val_one]⟩
        refine ⟨w' * w, mul_mem hw'mem hwmem, ?_⟩
        have hgt := galAutVal_zetaSys_pow p a hn 1
        rw [pow_one, mul_one] at hgt
        rw [Units.val_mul, hw'val, hwval, hξ,
          show -zetaSys p n = (-1) * zetaSys p n from by rw [neg_one_mul],
          galAutVal_mul p a (neg_mem (one_mem _)) (zetaSys_mem_K p n),
          galAutVal_neg_one p a, hgt, neg_one_mul]
      · 
        have hbne := ht_dvd b hb1 hb2
        have hzbne : zetaSys p n
            ^ (((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) :
              ZMod (p ^ n)).val * b) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
          refine sub_ne_zero_of_ne fun h => ?_
          have := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h
          rw [← (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).eq_orderOf] at this
          exact hbne this
        refine ⟨Units.mk0 _ hzbne, zetaSys_pow_sub_one_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hn
          (((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) : ZMod (p ^ n)).val * b)
          hbne (Units.mk0 _ hzbne) (by rw [Units.val_mk0]), ?_⟩
        have hgb := galAut_zetaSys_pow p a hn b
        rw [Units.val_mk0, hbv,
          galAutVal_mem p a (sub_mem (pow_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n) b) (one_mem _)),
          show (⟨zetaSys p n ^ b - 1,
              sub_mem (pow_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n) b) (one_mem _)⟩ : K p n)
              = ⟨zetaSys p n ^ b, pow_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n) b⟩ - 1 from
            Subtype.ext (by rw [AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub]; rfl), map_sub,
          AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub, hgb, map_one, IntermediateField.coe_one]
  | one =>
      refine ⟨1, one_mem _, ?_⟩
      have := galAutVal_zetaSys_pow p a hn 0
      rw [pow_zero, Nat.mul_zero, pow_zero] at this
      rw [Units.val_one, this]
  | mul z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁mem, hw₁val⟩ := ih₁
      obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂mem, hw₂val⟩ := ih₂
      have h1 : (z₁ : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hz₁
      have h2 : (z₂ : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hz₂
      refine ⟨w₁ * w₂, mul_mem hw₁mem hw₂mem, ?_⟩
      rw [Units.val_mul, hw₁val, hw₂val, ← galAutVal_mul p a h1 h2, ← Units.val_mul]
  | inv z hz ih =>
      obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwval⟩ := ih
      have hzK : (z : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hz
      refine ⟨w⁻¹, Subgroup.inv_mem _ hwmem, ?_⟩
      rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, hwval, ← galAutVal_inv p a hzK, ← Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]

name: galAutValU_val_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [galAutValU, dif_pos h, galAutUnit_val, galAutVal_mem p a h]

name: cycloUnitU_val
statement:
private theorem cycloUnitU_val {b : ℕ} (hb : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (cycloUnitU p hb hn : ℂ_[p]) = cycloUnit p b n
proof: := Units.val_mk0 _

name: prod_galAutValU_cycloUnit_telescope
statement:
private theorem prod_galAutValU_cycloUnit_telescope (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {b : ℕ} (hb0 : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ b)
    (hb : ((b : ZMod (p ^ n))) = (PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ)) (r : ℕ)
    {b' : ℕ} (hb' : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ b') (hbb' : ((b' : ZMod (p ^ n))) = (b : ZMod (p ^ n)) ^ r) :
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range r, galAutValU p (a ^ i) n (cycloUnitU p hb0 hn)
      = cycloUnitU p hb' hn
proof:
:= by
  refine Units.ext ?_
  rw [cycloUnitU_val]
  
  have hcoe : ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range r, galAutValU p (a ^ i) n (cycloUnitU p hb0 hn) : ℂ_[p]ˣ)
      : ℂ_[p])
      = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range r, galAutVal p (a ^ i) n (cycloUnit p b n) := by
    rw [Units.coe_prod]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hmemK : (cycloUnitU p hb0 hn : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := by
      rw [cycloUnitU_val]; exact cycloUnit_mem_K p b hn
    rw [galAutValU_val_mem p (a ^ i) hmemK, cycloUnitU_val]
  rw [hcoe, prod_galAutVal_cycloUnit_telescope p a hn hb r, cycloUnit]
  congr 2
  refine zetaSys_pow_eq_pow_of_modEq p ?_
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id, hbb']

name: galAutValU_mem_cycloUnits
statement:
private theorem galAutValU_mem_cycloUnits (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ}
    (hv : v ∈ cycloUnits p n) : galAutValU p a n v ∈ cycloUnits p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycloUnits, Subgroup.mem_inf] at hv ⊢
  obtain ⟨hvclos, hvF, hvint, hvintinv⟩ := hv
  have hvK : (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hvclos
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwval⟩ := galAut_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p a hn hvclos
    rwa [show galAutValU p a n v = w from
      Units.ext (by rw [hwval, galAutValU_val_mem p a hvK])]
  · rw [galAutValU_val_mem p a hvK, galAutVal_mem p a hvK]
    exact galAut_mem_Fglobal p a hn hvF hvK
  · rw [galAutValU_val_mem p a hvK, galAutVal_mem p a hvK]
    exact galAut_isIntegral p a hvK hvint
  · 
    have hinveq : (((galAutValU p a n v)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])
        = galAutVal p a n ((v : ℂ_[p])⁻¹) := by
      rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, galAutValU_val_mem p a hvK, ← galAutVal_inv p a hvK]
    rw [hinveq, galAutVal_mem p a ((K p n).inv_mem hvK)]
    have : ((v⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = (v : ℂ_[p])⁻¹ := Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val v
    exact galAut_isIntegral p a ((K p n).inv_mem hvK) (this ▸ hvintinv)

name: cycloUnit_mem_cycloTranslateSubgroup
statement:
theorem cycloUnit_mem_cycloTranslateSubgroup (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {b : ℕ} (hb0 : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ b)
    (hb : ((b : ZMod (p ^ n))) = (PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n a : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ))
    {b' : ℕ} (hb' : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ b') {r : ℕ}
    (hbb' : ((b' : ZMod (p ^ n))) = (b : ZMod (p ^ n)) ^ r) :
    cycloUnitU p hb' hn ∈ cycloTranslateSubgroup p n (cycloUnitU p hb0 hn)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_galAutValU_cycloUnit_telescope p a hn hb0 hb r hb' hbb']
  
  refine prod_mem fun i _ => ?_
  exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨a ^ i, rfl⟩

name: galNCU_elems_eq_galAutValU
statement:
theorem galNCU_elems_eq_galAutValU (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (u : NormCompatUnits p) (n : ℕ) :
    (galNCU p a u).elems n = galAutValU p a n (u.elems n)
proof:
:= by
  refine Units.ext ?_
  rw [galNCU_elems_val p a u n, galAutValU_val_mem p a (Subring.mem_inf.1 (u.mem n)).1,
    galAutVal_mem p a (Subring.mem_inf.1 (u.mem n)).1]

name: galNCU_pow
statement:
private theorem galNCU_pow (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (u : NormCompatUnits p) (k : ℕ) :
    galNCU p a (u ^ k) = (galNCU p a u) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, galNCU_one]
  | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, galNCU_mul, ih]

name: galNCU_inv
statement:
theorem galNCU_inv (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (u : NormCompatUnits p) :
    galNCU p a u⁻¹ = (galNCU p a u)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rw [← galNCU_mul, inv_mul_cancel, galNCU_one])

name: galAutValU_zero
statement: private theorem galAutValU_zero (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (v : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : galAutValU p a 0 v = v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p 0
  · refine Units.ext ?_
    rw [galAutValU_val_mem p a h, galAutVal_mem p a h,
      show galAut p a 0 = AlgEquiv.refl from by rw [galAut, dif_neg (by omega)]]
    rfl
  · rw [galAutValU, dif_neg h]

name: galNCU_neg_one_involutive
statement:
theorem galNCU_neg_one_involutive (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (u : NormCompatUnits p) :
    galNCU p (-1) (galNCU p (-1) u) = u
proof:
:= by
  refine NormCompatUnits.ext (funext fun n => Units.ext ?_)
  rw [galNCU_elems_eq_galAutValU, galNCU_elems_eq_galAutValU]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · rw [galAutValU_zero, galAutValU_zero]
  · have hmem : (u.elems n : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := (Subring.mem_inf.1 (u.mem n)).1
    have hinnerK : (galAutValU p (-1) n (u.elems n) : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := by
      rw [galAutValU_val_mem p (-1) hmem, galAutVal_mem p (-1) hmem]; exact SetLike.coe_mem _
    rw [galAutValU_val_mem p (-1) hinnerK, galAutValU_val_mem p (-1) hmem,
      galAutVal_mem p (-1) hmem, galAutVal_mem p (-1) (SetLike.coe_mem _)]
    have h2 : galAut p (-1) n * galAut p (-1) n = 1 := by
      have h := pow_orderOf_eq_one (galAut p (-1) n)
      rwa [orderOf_galAut_neg_one p hp2 hn, sq] at h
    rw [show (⟨(galAut p (-1) n ⟨(u.elems n : ℂ_[p]), hmem⟩ : ℂ_[p]), SetLike.coe_mem _⟩ : K p n)
        = galAut p (-1) n ⟨(u.elems n : ℂ_[p]), hmem⟩ from Subtype.ext rfl,
      ← AlgEquiv.mul_apply, h2, AlgEquiv.one_apply]

name: galNCU_neg_one_fixed_mem_unitsTower1Plus
statement:
theorem galNCU_neg_one_fixed_mem_unitsTower1Plus (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {w : NormCompatUnits p}
    (hw : w ∈ unitsTower1 p) (hfix : galNCU p (-1) w = w) : w ∈ unitsTower1Plus p
proof:
:= fun n hn => by
  have hone : w.elems n ∈ localUnitsOne p n := hw n hn
  have hmem : (w.elems n : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := (Subring.mem_inf.1 hone.1.1).1
  rw [mem_localUnitsOnePlus_iff_galAut_fixed p hp2 hn hone]
  have he : galAutValU p (-1) n (w.elems n) = w.elems n := by
    have h := congrFun (congrArg NormCompatUnits.elems hfix) n
    rwa [galNCU_elems_eq_galAutValU] at h
  have hev := congrArg (fun x : ℂ_[p]ˣ => (x : ℂ_[p])) he
  rwa [galAutValU_val_mem p (-1) hmem, galAutVal_mem p (-1) hmem] at hev

name: continuousOn_galAutVal_K
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_galAutVal_K (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (galAutVal p a n) (K p n : Set ℂ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
  have hcont : Continuous (galAut p a n) :=
    (galAut p a n).toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
  
  have hid : Continuous (fun x : (K p n : Set ℂ_[p]) => (⟨x.1, x.2⟩ : K p n)) :=
    continuous_induced_rng.mpr continuous_induced_dom
  
  have heq : (K p n : Set ℂ_[p]).restrict (galAutVal p a n)
      = fun x : (K p n : Set ℂ_[p]) => ((galAut p a n ⟨x.1, x.2⟩ : K p n) : ℂ_[p]) :=
    funext fun x => galAutVal_mem p a x.2
  rw [heq]
  exact continuous_induced_dom.comp (hcont.comp hid)

name: continuousOn_galAutValU_K
statement:
private theorem continuousOn_galAutValU_K (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (galAutValU p a n) {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.isInducing_embedProduct.continuousOn_iff]
  
  have hval : ∀ v ∈ {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n},
      ((galAutValU p a n v : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = galAutVal p a n (v : ℂ_[p]) :=
    fun v hv => galAutValU_val_mem p a hv
  have hinv : ∀ v ∈ {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n},
      (((galAutValU p a n v)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) = galAutVal p a n ((v : ℂ_[p])⁻¹) := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, galAutValU_val_mem p a hv, ← galAutVal_inv p a hv]
  
  
  have hcoeinv : Continuous (fun v : ℂ_[p]ˣ => ((v : ℂ_[p])⁻¹)) := by
    simp_rw [← Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]; exact Units.continuous_coe_inv
  refine ContinuousOn.prodMk ?_ (MulOpposite.continuous_op.comp_continuousOn ?_)
  · exact ((continuousOn_galAutVal_K p a n).comp Units.continuous_val.continuousOn
      (fun v hv => hv)).congr hval
  · exact ((continuousOn_galAutVal_K p a n).comp hcoeinv.continuousOn
      (fun v hv => (K p n).inv_mem hv)).congr hinv

name: galAutValU_mem_topologicalClosure_cycloUnits
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Subgroup.topologicalClosure_coe] at hv ⊢
  
  have hsubK : (cycloUnits p n : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) ⊆ {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n} := by
    intro w hw
    exact mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p (Subgroup.mem_inf.1 hw).1
  
  
  have hKc : IsClosed ((K p n : Set ℂ_[p])) := by
    haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] (K p n) := Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (R := ℚ_[p])
      (by rw [finrank_K]; exact Nat.totient_pos.2 (pow_pos hp.out.pos n))
    have h := Submodule.closed_of_finiteDimensional ((K p n).toSubalgebra.toSubmodule)
    convert h using 1
  have hKclosed : IsClosed {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n} :=
    hKc.preimage Units.continuous_val
  
  have hclosureK : closure (cycloUnits p n : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) ⊆ {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n} :=
    closure_minimal hsubK hKclosed
  
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (galAutValU p a n) (cycloUnits p n : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ)
      (cycloUnits p n : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) :=
    fun w hw => galAutValU_mem_cycloUnits p a hn hw
  exact hmaps.closure_of_continuousOn ((continuousOn_galAutValU_K p a n).mono hclosureK) hv

name: galNCU_neg_one_mem_cycloTower1
statement:
theorem galNCU_neg_one_mem_cycloTower1 {u : NormCompatUnits p} (hu : u ∈ cycloTower1 p) :
    galNCU p (-1) u ∈ cycloTower1 p
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  
  rw [galNCU_elems_eq_galAutValU]
  
  have hv := hu n hn
  rw [cycloClosureOne, Subgroup.mem_inf, cycloClosure, Subgroup.mem_inf] at hv
  obtain ⟨⟨hvclos, _⟩, _⟩ := hv
  
  have hone : (galNCU p (-1) u).elems n ∈ localUnitsOne p n :=
    galNCU_mem_unitsTower1 p (-1) (cycloTower1_le_unitsTower1 p hu) n hn
  rw [galNCU_elems_eq_galAutValU] at hone
  
  have hclos : galAutValU p (-1) n (u.elems n) ∈ (cycloUnits p n).topologicalClosure :=
    galAutValU_mem_topologicalClosure_cycloUnits p (-1) hn hvclos
  rw [cycloClosureOne, Subgroup.mem_inf, cycloClosure, Subgroup.mem_inf]
  exact ⟨⟨hclos, ((mem_localUnitsOne_iff p).1 hone).1⟩, hone⟩

name: a0_not_dvd
statement: private theorem a0_not_dvd (hp2 : p ≠ 2) : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ a0 p hp2
proof:
:=
  (PadicMeasure.exists_nat_topological_generator p hp2).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: wGamma_mem_unitsTower1
statement: theorem wGamma_mem_unitsTower1 (hp2 : p ≠ 2) : wGamma p hp2 ∈ unitsTower1 p
proof:
:=
  (splitCyclo p hp2).2.1

name: wGammaTeich_torsion
statement:
private theorem wGammaTeich_torsion (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    ∀ n, (wGammaTeich p hp2).elems n ^ (p - 1) = 1
proof: := (splitCyclo p hp2).2.2.1

name: cyclo_eq_split
statement:
private theorem cyclo_eq_split (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2 = wGammaTeich p hp2 * wGamma p hp2
proof:
:=
  (splitCyclo p hp2).2.2.2

name: Col_wGamma
statement:
theorem Col_wGamma (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    Col p (wGamma p hp2) = -PadicMeasure.zetaNum p (a0 p hp2)
proof:
:= by
  have htor : Col p (wGammaTeich p hp2) = 0 :=
    Col_eq_zero_of_torsion p _ (wGammaTeich_torsion p hp2)
  have hsplit : Col p (cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2)
      = Col p (wGammaTeich p hp2) + Col p (wGamma p hp2) := by
    rw [cyclo_eq_split p hp2, Col_add]
  rw [Col_cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2] at hsplit
  rw [htor, zero_add] at hsplit
  rw [← hsplit]

name: Col_wGamma_choose
statement:
theorem Col_wGamma_choose (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    Col p (wGamma p hp2)
      = -PadicMeasure.zetaNum p (PadicMeasure.exists_nat_topological_generator p hp2).choose
proof:
:=
  Col_wGamma p hp2

name: elems_pow'
statement:
private theorem elems_pow' (u : NormCompatUnits p) (k n : ℕ) :
    (u ^ k).elems n = (u.elems n) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]; rfl
  | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ← ih]; rfl

name: wGamma_pow_eq_cyclo_pow
statement:
private theorem wGamma_pow_eq_cyclo_pow (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    wGamma p hp2 ^ (p - 1) = cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2 ^ (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cyclo_eq_split p hp2, mul_pow]
  have hvpow : wGammaTeich p hp2 ^ (p - 1) = 1 := by
    apply NormCompatUnits.ext; funext n
    rw [elems_pow' p, wGammaTeich_torsion p hp2 n]; rfl
  rw [hvpow, one_mul]

name: wGamma_pow_mem_cycloTower1
statement: theorem wGamma_pow_mem_cycloTower1 (hp2 : p ≠ 2) : wGamma p hp2 ^ (p - 1) ∈ cycloTower1 p
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  have hmem : wGamma p hp2 ^ (p - 1) ∈ unitsTower1 p :=
    pow_mem (wGamma_mem_unitsTower1 p hp2) (p - 1)
  rw [cycloClosureOne, Subgroup.mem_inf]
  refine ⟨?_, hmem n hn⟩
  rw [cycloClosure, Subgroup.mem_inf]
  refine ⟨?_, ((mem_localUnitsOne_iff p).1 (hmem n hn)).1⟩
  
  rw [wGamma_pow_eq_cyclo_pow p hp2, elems_pow' p]
  exact pow_mem (Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _
    (cyclo_elems_mem_cycloUnits p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2 hn)) (p - 1)

name: wGamma_mem_cycloTower1
statement: theorem wGamma_mem_cycloTower1 (hp2 : p ≠ 2) : wGamma p hp2 ∈ cycloTower1 p
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  
  have hg : (wGamma p hp2).elems n ∈ localUnitsOne p n := wGamma_mem_unitsTower1 p hp2 n hn
  have hgpow : ((wGamma p hp2).elems n) ^ (p - 1) ∈ cycloClosureOne p n := by
    have := wGamma_pow_mem_cycloTower1 p hp2 n hn
    rwa [elems_pow' p] at this
  
  exact mem_cycloClosureOne_of_pow_mem p hg hgpow

name: galNCU_wGamma_mem_cycloTower1
statement:
theorem galNCU_wGamma_mem_cycloTower1 (a : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    galNCU p a (wGamma p hp2) ∈ cycloTower1 p
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  
  have hg : (galNCU p a (wGamma p hp2)).elems n ∈ localUnitsOne p n :=
    galNCU_mem_unitsTower1 p a (wGamma_mem_unitsTower1 p hp2) n hn
  refine mem_cycloClosureOne_of_pow_mem p hg ?_
  
  have hpow : ((galNCU p a (wGamma p hp2)).elems n) ^ (p - 1)
      = galAutValU p a n ((cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2).elems n ^ (p - 1)) := by
    rw [← elems_pow' p, ← galNCU_pow p a (wGamma p hp2) (p - 1),
      galNCU_elems_eq_galAutValU p a _ n, wGamma_pow_eq_cyclo_pow p hp2, elems_pow' p]
  rw [hpow]
  
  have hcyc : (cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2).elems n ^ (p - 1) ∈ cycloUnits p n :=
    pow_mem (cyclo_elems_mem_cycloUnits p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2 hn) (p - 1)
  have hgalcyc : galAutValU p a n ((cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2).elems n ^ (p - 1))
      ∈ cycloUnits p n := galAutValU_mem_cycloUnits p a hn hcyc
  
  have hgprin : galAutValU p a n ((cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2).elems n ^ (p - 1))
      ∈ localUnitsOne p n := by rw [← hpow]; exact pow_mem hg (p - 1)
  rw [cycloClosureOne, Subgroup.mem_inf, cycloClosure, Subgroup.mem_inf]
  exact ⟨⟨Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _ hgalcyc,
    ((mem_localUnitsOne_iff p).1 hgprin).1⟩, hgprin⟩

name: wGamma_elems_pow_eq_cycloUnit_pow
statement:
theorem wGamma_elems_pow_eq_cycloUnit_pow (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ((wGamma p hp2).elems n : ℂ_[p]) ^ (p - 1) = cycloUnit p (a0 p hp2) n ^ (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun u : NormCompatUnits p => ((u.elems n : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]))
    (wGamma_pow_eq_cyclo_pow p hp2)
  simp only [elems_pow' p, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val] at h
  rw [h]
  
  change (((cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2).elems n : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) ^ (p - 1) = _
  rw [show (cyclo p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hp2).elems n
      = Units.mk0 (cycloUnit p (a0 p hp2) n) (cycloUnit_ne_zero p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hn) from by
    change (if h : 1 ≤ n then Units.mk0 (cycloUnit p (a0 p hp2) n) _ else 1) = _
    rw [dif_pos hn], Units.val_mk0]

name: cycloUnitU_a0_generates
statement:
theorem cycloUnitU_a0_generates (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {b' : ℕ} (hb' : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ b') :
    cycloUnitU p hb' hn
      ∈ cycloTranslateSubgroup p n (cycloUnitU p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hn)
proof:
:= by
  
  set u₀ : ℤ_[p]ˣ := (PadicMeasure.exists_nat_topological_generator p hp2).choose_spec.choose
    with hu₀
  have hu₀spec := (PadicMeasure.exists_nat_topological_generator p hp2).choose_spec.choose_spec
  
  have hval : (u₀ : ℤ_[p]) = (a0 p hp2 : ℤ_[p]) := hu₀spec.2.1
  have hres : ((a0 p hp2 : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ n))
      = (PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n u₀ : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) := by
    rw [PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow_coe, hval, map_natCast]
  
  have hgen : Subgroup.zpowers (PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n u₀) = ⊤ := hu₀spec.2.2 n
  haveI : NeZero (p ^ n) := ⟨(pow_pos hp.out.pos n).ne'⟩
  
  have hb'unit : IsUnit ((b' : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) := by
    rw [ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime]
    exact hp.out.coprime_pow_of_not_dvd (m := n) hb'
  
  obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ : ∃ r' : ℕ,
      (PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n u₀) ^ r' = hb'unit.unit := by
    have hmem : hb'unit.unit ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n u₀) :=
      hgen ▸ Subgroup.mem_top _
    rwa [← mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers] at hmem
  
  have hbb' : ((b' : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) = ((a0 p hp2 : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) ^ r' := by
    rw [hres]
    have := congrArg (fun x : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ => (x : ZMod (p ^ n))) hr'
    simp only [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, IsUnit.unit_spec] at this
    rw [← this]
  exact cycloUnit_mem_cycloTranslateSubgroup p u₀ hn (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hres hb' hbb'

name: galAutValU_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine Units.ext ?_
  rw [Units.val_mul, galAutValU_val_mem p c (by rw [Units.val_mul]; exact mul_mem hu hv),
    galAutValU_val_mem p c hu, galAutValU_val_mem p c hv, Units.val_mul,
    galAutVal_mul p c hu hv]

name: galAutValU_pow
statement:
private theorem galAutValU_pow (c : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} {u : ℂ_[p]ˣ} (hu : (u : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n)
    (k : ℕ) : galAutValU p c n (u ^ k) = (galAutValU p c n u) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]
    exact Units.ext (by rw [galAutValU_val_mem p c (one_mem _), Units.val_one,
      galAutVal_mem p c (one_mem _),
      show (⟨(1 : ℂ_[p]), one_mem _⟩ : K p n) = 1 from rfl, map_one, IntermediateField.coe_one])
  | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, galAutValU_mul p c (pow_mem hu m) hu, ih]

name: cycloUnitU_val_mem_K
statement:
private theorem cycloUnitU_val_mem_K {b : ℕ} (hb : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (cycloUnitU p hb hn : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycloUnitU_val]; exact cycloUnit_mem_K p b hn

name: map_pow_cycloTranslate_a0_le
statement:
private theorem map_pow_cycloTranslate_a0_le (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Subgroup.map (powMonoidHom (p - 1))
        (cycloTranslateSubgroup p n (cycloUnitU p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hn))
      ≤ cycloTranslateSubgroup p n ((wGamma p hp2).elems n)
proof:
:= by
  set g₀ : ℂ_[p]ˣ := (wGamma p hp2).elems n with hg₀
  
  have hbase : (cycloUnitU p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hn) ^ (p - 1) = g₀ ^ (p - 1) := by
    refine Units.ext ?_
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, cycloUnitU_val, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val,
      wGamma_elems_pow_eq_cycloUnit_pow p hp2 hn]
  have hg₀K : (g₀ : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := (Subring.mem_inf.1 ((wGamma p hp2).mem n)).1
  rw [cycloTranslateSubgroup, MonoidHom.map_closure, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  
  rw [powMonoidHom_apply,
    ← galAutValU_pow p c (cycloUnitU_val_mem_K p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hn) (p - 1), hbase,
    galAutValU_pow p c hg₀K (p - 1)]
  rw [cycloTranslateSubgroup]
  refine pow_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure ?_) (p - 1)
  exact ⟨c, rfl⟩

name: cycloUnitU_pow_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine map_pow_cycloTranslate_a0_le p hp2 hn ⟨cycloUnitU p hb hn, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact cycloUnitU_a0_generates p hp2 hn hb
  · rw [powMonoidHom_apply]

name: unitsToZModPow_neg_one_val_not_dvd
statement:
private theorem unitsToZModPow_neg_one_val_not_dvd {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ ((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n (-1) : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) : ZMod (p ^ n)).val
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero (p ^ n) := ⟨(pow_pos hp.out.pos n).ne'⟩
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime
      ((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n (-1) : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) : ZMod (p ^ n)).val (p ^ n) :=
    ZMod.val_coe_unit_coprime _
  have hcp : Nat.Coprime
      ((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n (-1) : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) : ZMod (p ^ n)).val p :=
    hcop.coprime_dvd_right (dvd_pow_self p (by omega))
  rw [Nat.coprime_comm] at hcp
  exact (hp.out.coprime_iff_not_dvd).1 hcp

name: galAutNegOne_cycloUnitU_mem
statement:
private theorem galAutNegOne_cycloUnitU_mem (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {b : ℕ}
    (hb : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ b) :
    galAutValU p (-1) n (cycloUnitU p hb hn)
      ∈ cycloTranslateSubgroup p n (cycloUnitU p (a0_not_dvd p hp2) hn)
proof:
:= by
  set t : ℕ := ((PadicMeasure.unitsToZModPow p n (-1) : (ZMod (p ^ n))ˣ) : ZMod (p ^ n)).val with ht
  have htnd : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ t := unitsToZModPow_neg_one_val_not_dvd p hn
  have htbnd : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ (t * b) := by
    rw [hp.out.prime.dvd_mul]; push_neg; exact ⟨htnd, hb⟩
  
  have hword : galAutValU p (-1) n (cycloUnitU p hb hn)
      = cycloUnitU p htbnd hn * (cycloUnitU p htnd hn)⁻¹ := by
    refine Units.ext ?_
    rw [galAutValU_val_mem p (-1) (cycloUnitU_val_mem_K p hb hn), cycloUnitU_val,
      galAutVal_cycloUnit p (-1) hn b, Units.val_mul, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, cycloUnitU_val,
      cycloUnitU_val, cycloUnit, cycloUnit, ← ht]
    have hden : zetaSys p n - 1 ≠ 0 :=
      sub_ne_zero_of_ne ((zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).ne_one (one_lt_pow₀ hp.out.one_lt (by omega)))
    have htnum : zetaSys p n ^ t - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      refine sub_ne_zero_of_ne fun h => htnd ?_
      have hord := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h
      rw [← (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).eq_orderOf] at hord
      exact (dvd_pow_self p (by omega : n ≠ 0)).trans hord
    
    field_simp
  rw [hword]
  exact mul_mem (cycloUnitU_a0_generates p hp2 hn htbnd)
    (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (cycloUnitU_a0_generates p hp2 hn htnd))

name: zetaSys_pow_neg_one_val
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := galAut_zetaSys p (-1) hn
  rw [galAutNegOne_zetaSys p hn] at h1
  exact h1.symm

name: zetaSys_ne_neg_one
statement:
private theorem zetaSys_ne_neg_one (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    zetaSys p n ≠ -1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hsq : zetaSys p n ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [h]; ring
  have hdvd : p ^ n ∣ 2 := (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).dvd_of_pow_eq_one 2 hsq
  have hp3 : 3 ≤ p := by have := hp.out.two_le; omega
  have : 3 ≤ p ^ n := le_trans hp3 (le_self_pow (by omega) (by omega))
  exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd) (by omega)

name: zetaSys_eq_cycloUnit_two_ratio
proof:
:= by
  have hξ0 : zetaSys p n ≠ 0 := zetaSys_ne_zero p n
  have hξ1 : zetaSys p n ≠ 1 :=
    (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).ne_one (one_lt_pow₀ hp.out.one_lt (by omega))
  have hden : zetaSys p n - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero_of_ne hξ1
  
  have hc2 : cycloUnit p 2 n = zetaSys p n + 1 := by
    rw [cycloUnit, div_eq_iff hden]; ring
  
  have hinvne : (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ - 1 ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero_of_ne (fun h => hξ1 (by rw [← inv_inv (zetaSys p n), h, inv_one]))
  have hσ : galAutVal p (-1) n (cycloUnit p 2 n) = 1 + (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ := by
    rw [galAutVal_cycloUnit p (-1) hn 2, pow_mul, zetaSys_pow_neg_one_val p hn, div_eq_iff hinvne]
    ring
  
  have h1inv : (1 : ℂ_[p]) + (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply zetaSys_ne_neg_one p hp2 hn
    have hinv : (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ = -1 := by linear_combination h
    rw [← inv_inv (zetaSys p n), hinv, inv_neg, inv_one]
  
  rw [hσ, hc2, ← div_eq_mul_inv, eq_div_iff h1inv, mul_add, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel₀ hξ0]

name: not_dvd_two
statement: private theorem not_dvd_two (hp2 : p ≠ 2) : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp.out Nat.prime_two).1 h
  exact hp2 this

name: galAutNegOne_cycloUnitU_pow_mem
statement:
private theorem galAutNegOne_cycloUnitU_pow_mem (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {b : ℕ}
    (hb : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ b) :
    (galAutValU p (-1) n (cycloUnitU p hb hn)) ^ (p - 1)
      ∈ cycloTranslateSubgroup p n ((wGamma p hp2).elems n)
proof:
:= by
  refine map_pow_cycloTranslate_a0_le p hp2 hn ⟨galAutValU p (-1) n (cycloUnitU p hb hn), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact galAutNegOne_cycloUnitU_mem p hp2 hn hb
  · rw [powMonoidHom_apply]

name: zetaSysUnit_pow_mem
statement:
private theorem zetaSysUnit_pow_mem (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    zetaSysUnit p n ^ (p - 1) ∈ cycloTranslateSubgroup p n ((wGamma p hp2).elems n)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ 2 := not_dvd_two p hp2
  
  have hword : zetaSysUnit p n ^ (p - 1)
      = (cycloUnitU p h2 hn) ^ (p - 1) * ((galAutValU p (-1) n (cycloUnitU p h2 hn)) ^ (p - 1))⁻¹ := by
    refine Units.ext ?_
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, zetaSysUnit_val, Units.val_mul, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val,
      cycloUnitU_val, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val,
      galAutValU_val_mem p (-1) (cycloUnitU_val_mem_K p h2 hn), cycloUnitU_val, ← inv_pow,
      ← mul_pow, ← zetaSys_eq_cycloUnit_two_ratio p hp2 hn]
  rw [hword]
  exact mul_mem (cycloUnitU_pow_mem p hp2 hn h2)
    (Subgroup.inv_mem _ (galAutNegOne_cycloUnitU_pow_mem p hp2 hn h2))

name: cycloUnits_normalForm
statement:
private theorem cycloUnits_normalForm (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {d : ℂ_[p]ˣ}
    (hd : d ∈ cycloUnits p n) :
    ∃ (D : ℤ) (h : ℂ_[p]ˣ), h ∈ Subgroup.closure (gammaGenSet p n)
      ∧ d = zetaSysUnit p n ^ D * h
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycloUnits, Subgroup.mem_inf] at hd
  obtain ⟨hdClosure, hdGlobal⟩ := hd
  have hdAug : d ∈ Subgroup.closure (augGenSet p hn) :=
    closure_cycloGenSet_le_aug p hp2 hn hdClosure
  obtain ⟨D, E, h, hh, hDEh⟩ := mem_aug_normal_form p hn hdAug
  
  have hdNorm : ‖(d : ℂ_[p])‖ = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨_, hint, hintInv⟩ := hdGlobal
    have h1 : ‖(d : ℂ_[p])‖ ≤ 1 := norm_le_one_of_isIntegral_int p hint
    have h2 : ‖((d⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p])‖ ≤ 1 := norm_le_one_of_isIntegral_int p hintInv
    rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, norm_inv] at h2
    have hpos : 0 < ‖(d : ℂ_[p])‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr d.ne_zero
    exact le_antisymm h1 ((inv_le_one₀ hpos).mp h2)
  have hdVal : valHom p d = 1 := valHom_eq_one_of_norm_one p hdNorm
  have hξVal : valHom p (zetaSysUnit p n) = 1 :=
    valHom_eq_one_of_norm_one p (by rw [zetaSysUnit_val, norm_zetaSys_eq_one])
  have hhVal : valHom p h = 1 := valHom_eq_one_of_mem_closure_gammaGenSet p hn hh
  
  have hδpow : valHom p (deltaUnit p hn) ^ E = 1 := by
    have := congrArg (valHom p) hDEh
    rw [hdVal, map_mul, map_mul, map_zpow, map_zpow, hξVal, hhVal, one_zpow, one_mul,
      mul_one] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hE0 : E = 0 := by
    by_contra hE
    apply valHom_deltaUnit_ne_one p hn
    set c : ℝ := -Real.log ‖(deltaUnit p hn : ℂ_[p])‖ with hc
    have hval : valHom p (deltaUnit p hn) = Multiplicative.ofAdd c := rfl
    rw [hval, ← ofAdd_zsmul, ofAdd_eq_one, zsmul_eq_mul] at hδpow
    rw [hval, ofAdd_eq_one]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hδpow with hEz | hcz
    · exact absurd (by exact_mod_cast hEz) hE
    · exact hcz
  refine ⟨D, h, hh, ?_⟩
  rw [hDEh, hE0, zpow_zero, mul_one]

name: gammaUnit_pow_mem
proof:
:= by
  
  have hword : g = zetaSysUnit p n ^ ((halfExp p b n).val) * cycloUnitU p hb hn := by
    refine Units.ext ?_
    rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, zetaSysUnit_val, cycloUnitU_val, hgv, gammaUnit,
      show zetaSys p n ^ ((halfExp p b n).val) = zhp p (halfExp p b n) from rfl]
  rw [hword, mul_pow]
  refine mul_mem ?_ (cycloUnitU_pow_mem p hp2 hn hb)
  
  rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]
  exact pow_mem (zetaSysUnit_pow_mem p hp2 hn) _

name: map_pow_gammaGenSet_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.map_closure, Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  rw [powMonoidHom_apply]
  rcases hg with ⟨b, hb, hgv⟩ | hgv
  · exact gammaUnit_pow_mem p hp2 hn hb hgv
  · 
    have hg1 : g = -1 := Units.ext (by rw [hgv]; simp)
    rw [hg1, Even.neg_one_pow (Nat.Prime.even_sub_one hp.out hp2)]
    exact one_mem _

name: cycloUnits_pow_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, h, hh, hDh⟩ := cycloUnits_normalForm p hp2 hn hd
  have hξD : (zetaSysUnit p n ^ D) ^ (p - 1) = (zetaSysUnit p n ^ (p - 1)) ^ D := by
    rw [← zpow_natCast (zetaSysUnit p n ^ D) (p - 1), ← zpow_mul, mul_comm, zpow_mul,
      zpow_natCast]
  rw [hDh, mul_pow, hξD]
  refine mul_mem (zpow_mem (zetaSysUnit_pow_mem p hp2 hn) D) ?_
  exact map_pow_gammaGenSet_le p hp2 hn ⟨h, hh, by rw [powMonoidHom_apply]⟩

name: closure_zpPow_mem
statement:
private theorem closure_zpPow_mem (G : Subgroup ℂ_[p]ˣ) {y : ℂ_[p]ˣ}
    (hyc : ‖(y : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1) (hyclos : y ∈ G.topologicalClosure)
    (a : ℤ_[p]) {x : ℂ_[p]ˣ} (hx : (x : ℂ_[p]) = zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) a) :
    x ∈ G.topologicalClosure
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p])) := by
    have h : zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) = (PadicInt.addChar_of_value_at_one ((y : ℂ_[p]) - 1)
        (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_iff_norm_lt_one.mpr hyc) : ℤ_[p] → ℂ_[p]) := by
      funext c; rw [zpPow, dif_pos (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_iff_norm_lt_one.mpr hyc)]
    rw [h]; exact PadicInt.continuous_addChar_of_value_at_one _
  set F : ℤ_[p] → ℂ_[p]ˣ := fun c => ⟨zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) c, zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) (-c),
    by rw [← zpPow_add p hyc, add_neg_cancel, show (0 : ℤ_[p]) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) by norm_cast,
      zpPow_natCast p hyc, pow_zero],
    by rw [← zpPow_add p hyc, neg_add_cancel, show (0 : ℤ_[p]) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) by norm_cast,
      zpPow_natCast p hyc, pow_zero]⟩ with hF
  have hFval : ∀ c, (F c : ℂ_[p]) = zpPow p (y : ℂ_[p]) c := fun _ => rfl
  have hFcont : Continuous F := Units.continuous_iff.2 ⟨hcont, hcont.comp continuous_neg⟩
  have hFnat : ∀ k : ℕ, F (k : ℤ_[p]) = y ^ k := by
    intro k; refine Units.ext ?_
    rw [hFval, zpPow_natCast p hyc, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
  have hxF : x = F a := Units.ext (by rw [hFval]; exact hx)
  have hrange : Set.range F ⊆ closure ((G.topologicalClosure) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by
    have h1 : Set.range F = F '' (closure (Set.range (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ_[p]))) := by
      rw [PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.closure_range, Set.image_univ]
    rw [h1]
    refine (image_closure_subset_closure_image hFcont).trans (closure_mono ?_)
    rw [← Set.range_comp]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    show (F ∘ Nat.cast) k ∈ ((G.topologicalClosure) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ)
    rw [Function.comp_apply, hFnat k]
    exact pow_mem hyclos k
  have hxmem : x ∈ closure ((G.topologicalClosure) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by
    rw [hxF]; exact hrange ⟨a, rfl⟩
  rwa [(Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).closure_eq, SetLike.mem_coe] at hxmem

name: cycloClosureOnePlus_le_closure_wGammaTranslate
statement:
theorem cycloClosureOnePlus_le_closure_wGammaTranslate (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (cycloClosureOnePlus p n : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) ⊆
      _root_.closure (cycloTranslateSubgroup p n ((wGamma p hp2).elems n) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ)
proof:
:= by
  set H : Subgroup ℂ_[p]ˣ := cycloTranslateSubgroup p n ((wGamma p hp2).elems n) with hH
  intro u hu
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, cycloClosureOnePlus, Subgroup.mem_inf, cycloClosurePlus,
    Subgroup.mem_inf, cycloClosure, Subgroup.mem_inf] at hu
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨huClos, _⟩, _⟩, huOne⟩ := hu
  
  have hgc : ‖(u : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1 := ((mem_localUnitsOne_iff p).1 huOne).2
  
  have hpw : Continuous (fun v : ℂ_[p]ˣ => v ^ (p - 1)) := continuous_pow (p - 1)
  have himg : (fun v : ℂ_[p]ˣ => v ^ (p - 1)) '' (cycloUnits p n : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) ⊆ (H : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by
    rintro _ ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
    exact cycloUnits_pow_mem p hp2 hn hd
  have huClos' : u ∈ closure ((cycloUnits p n) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by
    rwa [← Subgroup.topologicalClosure_coe, SetLike.mem_coe]
  have hupow : u ^ (p - 1) ∈ _root_.closure (H : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by
    have h1 : u ^ (p - 1) ∈ (fun v : ℂ_[p]ˣ => v ^ (p - 1)) '' closure ((cycloUnits p n) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) :=
      ⟨u, huClos', rfl⟩
    have h2 := image_closure_subset_closure_image hpw h1
    exact closure_mono himg h2
  
  have hunit : IsUnit ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) :=
    PadicInt.isUnit_iff.mpr PadicInt.norm_natCast_p_sub_one
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hunit.exists_left_inv
  have hupowc : ‖((u ^ (p - 1) : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) - 1‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← zpPow_natCast p hgc]
    exact norm_zpPow_sub_one_lt_one p hgc _
  have hueq : (u : ℂ_[p]) = zpPow p ((u ^ (p - 1) : ℂ_[p]ˣ) : ℂ_[p]) c := by
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
    have hpow : (u : ℂ_[p]) ^ (p - 1) = zpPow p (u : ℂ_[p]) ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) :=
      (zpPow_natCast p hgc (p - 1)).symm
    rw [hpow, ← zpPow_mul p hgc, mul_comm, hc,
      show (1 : ℤ_[p]) = ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p]) by norm_cast, zpPow_natCast p hgc, pow_one]
  
  rw [← Subgroup.topologicalClosure_coe, SetLike.mem_coe] at hupow
  rw [← Subgroup.topologicalClosure_coe, SetLike.mem_coe]
  exact closure_zpPow_mem p H hupowc hupow c hueq

name: galAutVal_neg_one_zetaSys
statement:

proof:
:= by

name: galAutVal_neg_one_zetaSys_pow
statement:
private theorem galAutVal_neg_one_zetaSys_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a : ℕ) :
    galAutVal p (-1) n (zetaSys p n ^ a) = (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ ^ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [galAutVal_zetaSys_pow p (-1) hn a, pow_mul, zetaSys_pow_neg_one_val p hn]

name: anti_val_zetaSys_pow_sub_one
statement:
private theorem anti_val_zetaSys_pow_sub_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {a : ℕ}
    (ha1 : 1 ≤ a) (ha2 : a ≤ p ^ n - 1) :
    (zetaSys p n ^ a - 1) * (galAutVal p (-1) n (zetaSys p n ^ a - 1))⁻¹
      = -(zetaSys p n ^ a)
proof:
:= by
  have hξa : (zetaSys p n ^ a : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := pow_mem (zetaSys_mem_K p n) a
  have hξ0 : zetaSys p n ≠ 0 := zetaSys_ne_zero p n
  
  have hane : zetaSys p n ^ a ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hdvd : p ^ n ∣ a := (zetaSys_primitiveRoot p n).dvd_of_pow_eq_one a h
    have hple : p ^ n ≤ a := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
    have : a < p ^ n := by have := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp (pow_pos hp.out.pos n); omega
    omega
  have hden : zetaSys p n ^ a - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero_of_ne hane
  
  have hσ : galAutVal p (-1) n (zetaSys p n ^ a - 1) = (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ ^ a - 1 := by
    rw [show (zetaSys p n ^ a - 1 : ℂ_[p]) = zetaSys p n ^ a + (-1) from by ring,
      galAutVal_add p (-1) hξa (neg_mem (one_mem _)), galAutVal_neg_one p (-1),
      galAutVal_neg_one_zetaSys_pow p hn a]
    ring
  rw [hσ]
  
  have hpa0 : (zetaSys p n) ^ a ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero a hξ0
  have hbinv : (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ ^ a * zetaSys p n ^ a = 1 := by
    rw [inv_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpa0]
  
  have hden' : (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ ^ a - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hb1 : (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ ^ a = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    have hh := hbinv
    rw [hb1, one_mul] at hh
    exact hane hh
  have hbinv' : zetaSys p n ^ a * (zetaSys p n)⁻¹ ^ a = 1 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact hbinv
  have hfac : zetaSys p n ^ a - 1 = -(zetaSys p n ^ a) * ((zetaSys p n)⁻¹ ^ a - 1) := by
    rw [neg_mul, mul_sub, mul_one, hbinv']; ring
  rw [hfac, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hden', mul_one]

name: galAutValU_one
statement: private theorem galAutValU_one (c : ℤ_[p]ˣ) (n : ℕ) : galAutValU p c n 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by
    rw [galAutValU_val_mem p c (by rw [Units.val_one]; exact one_mem _), Units.val_one,
      galAutVal_mem p c (one_mem _),
      show (⟨(1 : ℂ_[p]), one_mem _⟩ : K p n) = 1 from rfl, map_one, IntermediateField.coe_one])

name: galAutValU_inv
statement:
private theorem galAutValU_inv (c : ℤ_[p]ˣ) {n : ℕ} {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ} (hv : (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n) :
    galAutValU p c n v⁻¹ = (galAutValU p c n v)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by
    rw [galAutValU_val_mem p c (by rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]; exact (K p n).inv_mem hv),
      Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, galAutValU_val_mem p c hv,
      ← galAutVal_inv p c hv])

name: anti_mem_zpowers_negZetaSysUnit
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      
      have hzK : (z : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p
        (Subgroup.subset_closure hz)
      rcases hz with hξ | hξ | ⟨a, ha1, ha2, hav⟩
      · 
        have hAval : (z : ℂ_[p]) * ((galAutValU p (-1) n z)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]) = zetaSys p n ^ 2 := by
          rw [galAutValU_val_mem p (-1) hzK, hξ, galAutVal_neg_one_zetaSys p hn, inv_inv]
          ring
        
        have hsq : z * (galAutValU p (-1) n z)⁻¹ = zetaSysUnit p n ^ 2 :=
          Units.ext (by rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, hAval,
            Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, zetaSysUnit_val])
        rw [hsq]
        exact pow_mem (zetaSysUnit_mem_zpowers_negZetaSysUnit p hp2 n) 2
      · 
        have hAval : (z : ℂ_[p]) * ((galAutValU p (-1) n z)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]) = zetaSys p n ^ 2 := by
          rw [galAutValU_val_mem p (-1) hzK, hξ,
            show galAutVal p (-1) n (-(zetaSys p n)) = -(zetaSys p n)⁻¹ from by
              rw [show (-(zetaSys p n) : ℂ_[p]) = (-1) * zetaSys p n from by ring,
                galAutVal_mul p (-1) (neg_mem (one_mem _)) (zetaSys_mem_K p n),
                galAutVal_neg_one p (-1), galAutVal_neg_one_zetaSys p hn]; ring,
            show (-(zetaSys p n)⁻¹)⁻¹ = -(zetaSys p n) from by rw [inv_neg, inv_inv]]
          ring
        have hsq : z * (galAutValU p (-1) n z)⁻¹ = zetaSysUnit p n ^ 2 :=
          Units.ext (by rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, hAval,
            Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, zetaSysUnit_val])
        rw [hsq]
        exact pow_mem (zetaSysUnit_mem_zpowers_negZetaSysUnit p hp2 n) 2
      · 
        have hAval : (z : ℂ_[p]) * ((galAutValU p (-1) n z)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p])
            = -(zetaSys p n ^ a) := by
          rw [galAutValU_val_mem p (-1) hzK, hav]
          exact anti_val_zetaSys_pow_sub_one p hn ha1 ha2
        
        have hna : z * (galAutValU p (-1) n z)⁻¹ = (-1) * zetaSysUnit p n ^ a :=
          Units.ext (by rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, hAval, Units.val_mul,
            Units.val_neg, Units.val_one, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, zetaSysUnit_val]; ring)
        rw [hna]
        exact mul_mem (negOne_mem_zpowers_negZetaSysUnit p hp2 n)
          (pow_mem (zetaSysUnit_mem_zpowers_negZetaSysUnit p hp2 n) a)
  | one =>
      rw [galAutValU_one, inv_one, mul_one]
      exact one_mem _
  | mul z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      have hK₁ : (z₁ : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hz₁
      have hK₂ : (z₂ : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hz₂
      rw [galAutValU_mul p (-1) hK₁ hK₂, mul_inv,
        mul_mul_mul_comm z₁ z₂ (galAutValU p (-1) n z₁)⁻¹ (galAutValU p (-1) n z₂)⁻¹]
      exact mul_mem ih₁ ih₂
  | inv z hz ih =>
      have hKz : (z : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n := mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hz
      rw [galAutValU_inv p (-1) hKz, inv_inv]
      rw [show z⁻¹ * galAutValU p (-1) n z = (z * (galAutValU p (-1) n z)⁻¹)⁻¹ from by
        rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_comm]]
      exact (Subgroup.zpowers (negZetaSysUnit p n)).inv_mem ih

name: cycloUnits_anti_mem_zpowers_negZeta
statement:
theorem cycloUnits_anti_mem_zpowers_negZeta (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {w : ℂ_[p]ˣ} (hw : w ∈ (cycloUnits p n).topologicalClosure) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, (w * (galAutValU p (-1) n w)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]) = (-(zetaSys p n)) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  
  set A : ℂ_[p]ˣ → ℂ_[p]ˣ := fun w => w * (galAutValU p (-1) n w)⁻¹ with hA
  set s : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ := (Subgroup.closure (cycloGenSet p n) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) with hs
  
  have hsK : s ⊆ {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n} := fun v hv =>
    mem_K_of_mem_closure_cycloGenSet p hv
  have hKc : IsClosed ((K p n : Set ℂ_[p])) := by
    haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] (K p n) := Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (R := ℚ_[p])
      (by rw [finrank_K]; exact Nat.totient_pos.2 (pow_pos hp.out.pos n))
    have h := Submodule.closed_of_finiteDimensional ((K p n).toSubalgebra.toSubmodule)
    convert h using 1
  have hKclosed : IsClosed {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n} :=
    hKc.preimage Units.continuous_val
  have hclosureK : closure s ⊆ {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n} :=
    closure_minimal hsK hKclosed
  
  have hAcont : ContinuousOn A {v : ℂ_[p]ˣ | (v : ℂ_[p]) ∈ K p n} :=
    continuousOn_id.mul ((continuousOn_galAutValU_K p (-1) n).inv)
  
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo A s (Subgroup.zpowers (negZetaSysUnit p n) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) :=
    fun v hv => anti_mem_zpowers_negZetaSysUnit p hp2 hn hv
  have hclosed_t : closure (Subgroup.zpowers (negZetaSysUnit p n) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ)
      = (Subgroup.zpowers (negZetaSysUnit p n) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) :=
    (isClosed_zpowers_negZetaSysUnit p hp2 n).closure_eq
  have hmapsClosure : Set.MapsTo A (closure s)
      (Subgroup.zpowers (negZetaSysUnit p n) : Set ℂ_[p]ˣ) := by
    have := hmaps.closure_of_continuousOn (hAcont.mono hclosureK)
    rwa [hclosed_t] at this
  
  have hwcl : w ∈ closure s := by
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Subgroup.topologicalClosure_coe] at hw
    refine closure_mono ?_ hw
    intro v hv
    exact (Subgroup.mem_inf.1 hv).1
  
  have hAw : A w ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (negZetaSysUnit p n) := hmapsClosure hwcl
  rw [Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff] at hAw
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hAw
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hval : (A w : ℂ_[p]) = (w * (galAutValU p (-1) n w)⁻¹ : ℂ_[p]) := rfl
  rw [← hval, ← hm, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, negZetaSysUnit_val]
